items.title: 比亞迪9月出口18萬輛、年增1.5倍！「這國」成最大市場
items.title_en: BYD exports 180,700 vehicles in September, up 1.5‑fold YoY! Brazil becomes its biggest market
paras: 比亞迪(002594-CN) 海外市場拓展持續升溫，出口成為支撐銷量的重要動能，9月出口18.07萬輛，年增約1.5倍，占當月總銷量近四成；今年前9個月累計出口134.3萬輛，年增92.66%，占總銷量比重達42.88%。
比亞迪今年前9個月總銷量為313.16萬輛，年減3.94%，顯示在整體銷量下滑之際，海外市場已成為比亞迪重要的成長來源。
根據51個海外市場數據，比亞迪及騰勢9月在45個市場實現零售，合計銷售10.6萬輛，較8月成長25.1%，也是該監測口徑下，單月海外零售首度突破10萬輛。
不過，出口與零售數據的統計範圍不同。比亞迪公布的18.07萬輛是整車出口數量，涵蓋全球所有市場；10.6萬輛則是45個市場的終端零售數據，不包括未納入監測的市場，以及尚在通路流通的車輛，因此兩者並不矛盾。
巴西成為比亞迪最大海外市場，歐洲緊追在後
從個別市場來看，巴西是比亞迪9月最大的海外市場，單月銷量達2.3萬輛，英國以2萬輛排名第二，澳洲則以8,576輛位居第三。
歐洲市場也展現一定規模，德國9月銷量為6,040輛，略高於印尼的6,039輛；義大利、西班牙及法國分別達5,159輛、4,434輛及3,848輛。
亞洲市場方面，印尼以6,039輛居首，其次為烏茲別克的4,558輛、南韓的2,614輛及泰國的2,130輛。此外，比亞迪在以色列、日本及馬來西亞分別銷售1,910輛、835輛及702輛。
整體而言，拉丁美洲與歐洲是比亞迪海外銷售的兩大支柱，大洋洲單月銷量也接近1萬輛；相較之下，亞洲市場的拓展仍有待進一步突破，非洲則尚待開發。
隨著海外銷量占比升至四成以上，比亞迪的成長動能正逐漸由中國市場延伸至全球。如何在既有主要市場持續擴大銷售，並在亞洲及非洲尋找新的成長機會，將是其海外布局的重要課題。
paras_en: BYD (002594-CN) continues to heat up its overseas market expansion, with exports becoming a key driver of sales. In September it exported 180,700 vehicles, about 1.5 times the volume a year earlier, accounting for nearly 40% of total sales that month; for the first nine months of the year it has shipped a cumulative 1.343 million vehicles, up 92.66% YoY and representing 42.88% of total sales.

For the first nine months of this year BYD’s total sales were 3.1316 million vehicles, down 3.94% year‑on‑year, showing that while overall sales are slipping, the overseas market has become an important source of growth for the company.

According to data from 51 overseas markets, BYD and its partner Tengshi achieved retail sales in 45 markets in September, totaling 106,000 vehicles, a 25.1% increase from August and the first time monthly overseas retail under this monitoring scope surpassed 100,000 units.

However, the export and retail figures cover different statistical scopes. BYD’s reported 180,700 units represent total vehicle exports to all global markets, whereas the 106,000 units are retail numbers from the 45 monitored markets, excluding unmonitored markets and vehicles still in distribution, so the two numbers are not contradictory.
Brazil has become BYD’s largest overseas market, with Europe close behind.
Looking at individual markets, Brazil was BYD’s biggest overseas market in September with 23,000 vehicles, the United Kingdom ranked second with 20,000, and Australia placed third with 8,576.

The European market also shows a sizable footprint: Germany sold 6,040 vehicles in September, slightly ahead of Indonesia’s 6,039; Italy, Spain and France recorded 5,159, 4,434 and 3,848 units respectively.
In Asia, Indonesia led with 6,039 units, followed by Uzbekistan with 4,558, South Korea with 2,614 and Thailand with 2,130. BYD also sold 1,910 vehicles in Israel, 835 in Japan and 702 in Malaysia.

Overall, Latin America and Europe are the two main pillars of BYD’s overseas sales, while Oceania’s monthly sales are close to 10,000 units; by contrast, expansion in the Asian market still needs further breakthroughs and Africa remains untapped.

As overseas sales now account for over 40% of total volume, BYD’s growth momentum is gradually shifting from the Chinese market to the global stage. How it continues to expand sales in its existing major markets and finds new growth opportunities in Asia and Africa will be a key challenge for its overseas strategy.

items.title: AI新創淘汰潮來襲！Character.AI聲請破產、OpenAI砍產品　42%企業AI專案遭放棄
items.title_en: AI Startups Facing Elimination Wave! Character.AI Files for Bankruptcy, OpenAI Cuts Products, 42% of Corporate AI Projects Abandoned
paras: 全球人工智慧（AI）產業正從融資與用戶成長競賽，轉向更嚴格的商業化考驗。曾估值10億美元的AI新創Character.AI聲請破產保護，累計融資約2.3億美元的AI硬體公司Humane也已退出AI Pin業務，就連OpenAI都陸續關閉或整併部分產品，顯示即使背靠熱門技術與龐大資金，也不代表企業能建立可持續的商業模式。
根據《TechCrunch 》報導，近年已有多家AI新創公司與明星專案倒閉、停運或轉型。
報導引述標普全球市場情報數據（S&P Global Market Intelligence）指出，約42%的企業AI專案最終遭到放棄，反映AI技術從展示功能走向實際商業應用，仍面臨資金、技術與市場需求等多重挑戰。

Character.AI坐擁千萬用戶　仍難擺脫虧損

AI聊天平台Character.AI是這波產業淘汰潮的代表案例。該公司由兩名前Google(GOOGL-US) 研究人員於2021年創立，憑藉AI虛擬角色聊天服務迅速走紅，2023年完成1.5億美元融資，估值達10億美元，成為AI獨角獸。
2024年，Google又透過據報價值約27億美元的技術授權及人才交易，讓兩位創辦人回歸。然而，龐大的用戶規模與資本挹注，仍未能解決公司的獲利問題。
根據《路透》報導，Character.AI聲請破產保護時仍有約1,200萬名活躍用戶，每月預估虧損卻高達800萬至900萬美元。
公司於10月12日正式聲請美國《破產法》第11章破產保護，迪士尼則以2,000萬美元成為部分資產交易的初始競標方。迪士尼此前曾向Character.AI發出侵權警告。
不過，聲請破產保護不代表平台立即關閉，Character.AI目前仍持續營運。

OpenAI也調整產品策略　部分服務遭關閉或整併

AI產業的產品淘汰並不限於新創公司。《TechCrunch》盤點指出，OpenAI也開始重新調整產品布局，陸續關閉部分服務或將功能整合至既有平台。
根據報導，OpenAI於2026年3月關閉獨立影片平台Sora，8月停止AI瀏覽器ChatGPT Atlas的獨立營運，並將部分功能整合進ChatGPT。
此前受到關注的Operator AI代理工具，也逐步融入ChatGPT產品體系。
此外，OpenAI曾嘗試將Chat、Codex與Work整合為超級應用程式，但因用戶回饋不佳，最終撤回相關設計。
這些調整不代表OpenAI放棄相關AI技術，而是重新選擇產品呈現方式與服務整合策略。
分析指出，對資源充足的大型科技公司而言，產品整併可以是策略調整；對收入來源集中於單一產品的新創公司來說，則可能直接影響企業存續。

42%企業AI專案遭放棄　技術展示難轉為實際收入

相較於個別企業倒閉，企業AI專案的高放棄率更凸顯產業商業化的難題。
《TechCrunch》引述標普全球市場情報數據數據指出，約42%的企業AI專案最終遭到放棄，原因包括資金不足、技術障礙、難以擴大規模、市場競爭激烈，以及用戶需求疲弱。
這項數據指的是企業內部AI專案的放棄比例，並非42%的AI新創公司破產。
過去，AI工具只要能生成報告、回答問題或展示新穎功能，就可能獲得企業預算。但隨著AI應用逐步落地，客戶開始更仔細評估導入成本、實際節省的人力，以及能否創造營收。
對AI業者而言，展示技術能力與證明商業價值是兩回事。即使產品能夠順利運作，若無法解決客戶的實際問題，仍難以建立穩定的付費需求。

AI應用燒錢又遇巨頭競爭　硬體新創也難突圍

AI服務的另一項挑戰，在於用戶規模與獲利能力未必同步成長。AI聊天、影片生成、即時語音及AI代理任務，都需要持續消耗運算資源，增加服務商的成本負擔。
除了Character.AI，AI自動化工具Relay於2026年8月關閉，AI音訊應用Huxe於5月停止營運，曾提供800多款模型比較服務的Yupp也於3月退出市場。
與此同時，OpenAI、Google等大型業者不斷將類似功能整合進自家平台，進一步壓縮獨立AI應用的生存空間。
對規模較小的業者而言，即使成功吸引用戶，也可能因無法有效變現，或面臨大型平台的競爭，而難以維持營運。
AI硬體同樣面臨類似困境。曾被視為下一代運算裝置的Humane AI Pin，累計融資約2.3億美元，但產品上市後陸續出現效能、使用體驗及電池安全問題。Humane於2025年2月停止AI Pin業務，大部分資產以1.16億美元出售給惠普(HPQ-US) 。
另一款AI硬體Rabbit R1上市初期銷量達10萬台，卻因功能有限、使用體驗不穩定而受到批評。不過，Rabbit並未倒閉，目前仍持續更新產品。

AI產業進入淘汰賽　資金規模不再是唯一指標

從Character.AI聲請破產保護、OpenAI調整產品，到Humane退出AI Pin業務，AI產業正逐步從追逐估值與用戶成長，轉向檢驗實際營運成果。
隨著市場更加重視商業化能力，營收、毛利率、客戶留存、運算成本與現金流，將成為評估AI企業價值的重要指標。無論是大型語言模型、AI代理、機器人或AI硬體，單靠技術概念與融資規模，都難以保證長期競爭力。
不過，部分企業退出市場，不代表AI產業整體走向衰退。隨著缺乏可持續商業模式的業者逐步退場，真正具備核心技術、明確客戶需求與商業化能力的企業，仍有機會在市場重新洗牌後取得優勢。
AI產業的競爭重心正在改變：過去比的是誰能取得更多資金、吸引更多用戶，如今則是誰能在控制成本的同時，持續創造實際價值。技術熱潮仍在延續，但並非每一家AI公司都能走到最後。
paras_en: The global artificial intelligence (AI) industry is shifting from a race of financing and user growth to a stricter test of commercialization. The AI startup Character.AI, once valued at $1 billion, has filed for bankruptcy protection, and the AI hardware company Humane, which had raised about $230 million, has exited the AI Pin business. Even OpenAI has been gradually shutting down or merging some products, showing that even with hot technology and massive funding, a company cannot guarantee a sustainable business model.
According to a TechCrunch report, several AI startups and star projects have closed, stopped, or pivoted in recent years.

The report cites S&P Global Market Intelligence data, indicating that about 42% of corporate AI projects are ultimately abandoned, reflecting that AI technology still faces multiple challenges—funding, technology, and market demand—when moving from demonstration to real commercial application.

Character.AI, an AI chat platform, is a representative case of this wave of industry elimination. The company was founded in 2021 by two former Google (GOOGL-US) researchers and quickly gained popularity with its AI virtual character chat service, raising $150 million in 2023 and reaching a valuation of $1 billion, becoming an AI unicorn.

In 2024, Google reportedly brought the two founders back through a technology licensing and talent deal valued at about $2.7 billion. However, the large user base and capital injection still did not solve the company's profitability issues.
According to Reuters, when Character.AI filed for bankruptcy protection, it still had about 12 million active users, but the monthly estimated loss was as high as $8–9 million.

The company officially filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection on October 12, and Disney became the initial bidder for part of the assets with $20 million. Disney had previously issued an infringement warning to Character.AI.
However, filing for bankruptcy protection does not mean the platform shuts down immediately; Character.AI is still operating.
OpenAI also adjusted its product strategy, with some services being shut down or merged into existing platforms.

According to reports, OpenAI shut down the independent video platform Sora in March 2026, stopped the independent operation of the AI browser ChatGPT Atlas in August, and integrated some features into ChatGPT.
The previously highlighted Operator AI agent tool has also been gradually integrated into the ChatGPT product ecosystem.
OpenAI also tried to combine Chat, Codex, and Work into a super app, but due to poor user feedback, it ultimately withdrew the design.
These adjustments do not mean OpenAI has abandoned the related AI technology; it is simply choosing a different product presentation and service integration strategy.

Analysts point out that for resource-rich large tech companies, product consolidation can be a strategic adjustment, while for startups whose revenue comes from a single product, it can directly affect the company's survival.
The high abandonment rate of corporate AI projects highlights the commercialization challenges of the industry more than individual company failures.

TechCrunch cites S&P Global Market Intelligence data indicating that about 42% of corporate AI projects are ultimately abandoned, due to reasons such as insufficient funding, technical obstacles, difficulty scaling, intense market competition, and weak user demand.
This data refers to the abandonment rate of internal corporate AI projects, not that 42% of AI startups have gone bankrupt.

In the past, AI tools that could generate reports, answer questions, or showcase novel features could secure corporate budgets. As AI applications gradually land, customers have begun to evaluate implementation costs, actual labor savings, and revenue generation more carefully.

For AI vendors, demonstrating technical capability and proving commercial value are two different things. Even if a product works smoothly, if it cannot solve the customer's real problems, it is still difficult to establish a stable paid demand.

Another challenge for AI services is that user scale and profitability do not necessarily grow together. AI chat, video generation, real‑time voice, and AI agent tasks all require continuous consumption of computing resources, increasing service provider costs.

Besides Character.AI, the AI automation tool Relay shut down in August 2026, the AI audio app Huxe ceased operations in May, and Yupp, which offered more than 800 model comparison services, exited the market in March.
At the same time, large players such as OpenAI and Google continuously integrate similar features into their own platforms, further shrinking the survival space for independent AI applications.
For smaller operators, even if they successfully attract users, they may struggle to monetize effectively or face competition from large platforms, making it hard to sustain operations.

AI hardware faces similar difficulties. The Humane AI Pin, once seen as the next-generation computing device, raised about $230 million but encountered performance, user experience, and battery safety issues after launch. Humane stopped the AI Pin business in February 2025, selling most assets for $116 million to HP (HPQ-US).

Another AI hardware, the Rabbit R1, sold 100 000 units in its early launch but was criticized for limited functionality and unstable user experience. However, Rabbit has not folded and continues to update its product.

The AI industry is entering an elimination phase; funding size is no longer the sole metric. From Character.AI filing for bankruptcy protection to OpenAI adjusting products and Humane exiting the AI Pin business, the industry is gradually moving from chasing valuation and user growth to testing actual operational results.

As the market places more emphasis on commercialization capabilities, revenue, gross margin, customer retention, computing cost, and cash flow will become key indicators for evaluating AI company value. Whether it is large language models, AI agents, robots, or AI hardware, relying solely on technical concepts and funding size cannot guarantee long-term competitiveness.

However, the exit of some companies does not mean the AI industry as a whole is declining. As companies lacking sustainable business models gradually leave the market, those with core technology, clear customer needs, and commercialization ability still have opportunities to gain an advantage after the market reshuffles.

The focus of AI industry competition is changing: in the past it was about who could raise more money and attract more users; today it is about who can continuously create real value while controlling costs. The technology hype continues, but not every AI company will make it to the end.

items.title: 銘福開發與大馬Naza集團簽MOU 合攻城市採礦商機
items.title_en: Mingfu Development Signs MOU with Malaysia's Naza Group to Jointly Pursue Urban Mining Opportunities
paras: 旗下控有包括金聯成(7865-TW)等逾30家企業的銘福集團，在海外事業布局跨出重要一大步，銘福集團旗下的銘福開發今(26)日與與馬來西亞Naza集團旗下Naza Enviro控股簽署合作備忘錄(MOU)，雙方將就馬國當地環保產業園區的城市採礦商機，進行研議技術及營運合作。
在此一台灣銘福開發與大馬知名的回收控股企業的合作規劃中，未來再進一步延伸至電池回收等領域。
今天簽約典禮由合作雙方高層出席，包含銘福集團創辦人兼董事長陳福松、副董事長陳奕潔、成功集團創辦人陳志遠等受邀出席。
銘福集團指出，隨著馬來西亞汽車市場持續成長，報廢車輛（ELVs）與廢棄車輛的處置已成重要課題，馬來西亞政府正積極透過環境部（DOE）與道路運輸部（JPJ）完善相關監管法規，重塑馬來西亞廢棄車輛的處置模式，致力打造兼具高標準有害廢棄物處理、廢液抽取與高價值材料回收的全方位現代化園區。
Naza Enviro是馬來西亞知名的回收控股，為當地各級提供市政服務。據統計，馬來西亞一年新車銷售逾80萬輛，其中電動車銷售銷量顯著增加，隨著當地汽車使用與電動化持續發展，雙方合作發潛力備受看好。
銘福集團50年來在台灣從事報廢車輛拆解、金屬回收及再生材料處理。這次雙方選定的馬來西亞BTEP環保園區，目前已有廢棄物處理、水處理、掩埋氣發電等設施，雙方合作將從報廢車輛的前端去污染、拆解分類及後端材料回收著手，結合銘福專業的處理實績，及Naza Enviro的環境管理與園區營運能力，研議適合當地的業務合作方案。
銘福集團副董事長陳奕潔表示，銘福在台灣實績有目共睹，但不同國家市場仍要從當地法規、車輛來源和處理需求出發，未來與進一步Naza集團洽談鉛酸蓄電池、鋰電池回收、再生材料處理等領域合作。銘福集團旗下金聯成、名仁資源的專業實力，將提供後續合作的堅強基礎。
paras_en: Mingfu Group, which controls more than 30 companies including Jin Lian Cheng (7865‑TW), has taken a major step in its overseas expansion. Today (the 26th), Mingfu Development, a subsidiary of Mingfu Group, signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Naza Enviro Holdings, a unit of Malaysia's Naza Group. The two parties will explore technical and operational cooperation on urban mining opportunities in an environmental industrial park in Malaysia.
Under this cooperation plan between Taiwan's Mingfu Development and the well‑known Malaysian recycling holding company, the partnership may later extend to battery recycling and related fields.

The signing ceremony was attended by senior executives from both sides, including Mingfu Group founder and chairman Chen Fu‑song, vice chairman Chen Yi‑jie, and Cheng Chih‑yuan, founder of Cheng‑gong Group, who were invited to the event.

Mingfu Group noted that as Malaysia's automobile market continues to grow, the disposal of end‑of‑life vehicles (ELVs) and waste vehicles has become a critical issue. The Malaysian government is actively strengthening related regulatory frameworks through the Department of Environment (DOE) and the Road Transport Department (JPJ) to reshape the country's vehicle waste disposal model, aiming to build a modern, comprehensive park that meets high standards for hazardous waste treatment, fluid extraction, and high‑value material recovery.

Naza Enviro is a well‑known Malaysian recycling holding company that provides municipal services at all levels. Statistics show that Malaysia sells over 800,000 new cars annually, with electric‑vehicle sales rising sharply. As local vehicle usage and electrification continue to develop, the potential of the partnership is viewed very positively.

Mingfu Group has spent 50 years in Taiwan dismantling end‑of‑life vehicles, recycling metals and processing recycled materials. The Malaysian BTEP environmental park selected for this cooperation already has facilities for waste treatment, water treatment and landfill gas power generation. The collaboration will address pollution control, dismantling and sorting at the front end of ELVs and material recovery at the back end, combining Mingfu's proven processing expertise with Naza Enviro's environmental management and park‑operating capabilities to devise a business model suited to the local market.

Vice chairman Chen Yi‑jie said that Mingfu's achievements in Taiwan are evident, but each foreign market must start from local regulations, vehicle sources and processing needs. Future talks with Naza Group will explore cooperation in lead‑acid battery, lithium‑ion battery recycling and recycled material processing. The professional strengths of Mingfu’s subsidiaries Jin Lian Cheng and Ming‑ren Resources will provide a solid foundation for subsequent collaboration.

items.title: CCL廠騰輝電子泰國新廠今開幕 昆山同步投資15億元擴產
items.title_en: CCL's Tenghui Electronics Opens New Factory in Thailand, Simultaneously Expands Production in Kunshan with NT$1.5 Billion Investment
paras: CCL(銅箔基板)電子材料製造商騰輝電子-KY(6672-TW)今(26)日於泰國大城府Hi-Tech工業園區舉行新廠開幕典禮，正式啟用集團在東南亞首座生產基地。配合全球供應鏈重組及AI高算力、資料中心等新興應用發展，騰輝電子同步推進泰國廠後續產能建置及中國昆山15億元擴產計畫，進一步強化全球製造布局、供應鏈韌性與高階材料競爭力。
騰輝電子-KY泰國新廠開幕典禮由騰輝董事長王有慈、執行長鍾健人、董事邱奕誠及集團副總王琢共同主持。大城府最高行政長官—府尹查瓦寧（Chawanin Wongsattjirakan）並率領當地核心首長團隊隆重出席，共同見證集團全球策略布局的重要里程碑。
騰輝電子-KY泰國新廠占地約3.5萬平方公尺，主要生產銅箔基板及黏合片，目前已開始小量出貨，預計2026年底正式量產，後續上膠產能將於2027年陸續開出，屆時泰國廠總設計產能預計再提升15%。新廠將落實China+1策略，除服務既有車用電子客戶外，也為未來資料中心及高階電子材料需求預作布局。
騰輝電子-KY指出，因應AI、高階運算與資料中心市場發展，騰輝-KY已於9月17日經董事會通過15億元昆山擴產預算，預計2027年第二季開始量產。結合泰國與昆山雙基地布局，集團將進一步提升全球產能調度彈性，強化國際客戶供應能力。
騰輝電子-KY指出，公司長期深耕少量多樣、高度客製化的特殊電子材料市場，未來將持續發揮技術與產品差異化優勢，積極拓展車用電子、散熱材料、超高頻雷達、航太國防及AI高算力等高附加價值應用。
騰輝電子-KY執行長鍾健人表示，泰國新廠的啟用，是騰輝全球發展的重要里程碑，也代表騰輝電子-KY對國際客戶長期承諾的具體實踐。面對全球供應鏈重組與新世代電子技術快速發展，騰輝電子-KY將持續透過技術創新、特殊材料及彈性生產能力，為客戶創造更高價值，並積極掌握AI、高階運算與高附加價值電子材料的成長契機。
騰輝電子-KY透過泰國新廠啟用與昆山同步擴產，騰輝-KY將持續完善全球製造與供應體系，深化國際客戶合作，為集團長期成長注入新動能。

台灣印刷電路板協會(TPCA)預估 2026 年整體發展態勢明顯優於過去兩年，全年海內外總產值有望首度破兆，達 1 兆 1,365 億元，年增 24.2%。同時，包括華通(2313-TW)、金像電(2368-TW)、欣興(3037-TW)、臻鼎-KY(4958-TW)及敬鵬(2355-TW)、定穎(3715-TW)等大型 PCB 業者，都積極在泰國持續大力投資。而CCL廠聯茂(6213-TW)、騰輝電子及台燿(6274-TW)都已在泰國設廠生產。台光電(2383-TW)則設廠馬來西亞。

泰國目前為東南亞最大的 PCB 生產基地，2025 年 PCB 產值已達 50.6 億美元，年增 22.4%，占全球產值約 5.4%。其成長動能主要來自台資、陸資廠新產能開出，帶動 AI 伺服器、高速網通與衛星通訊等高階應用在泰國生產比重快速提升。預估在 AI 基礎建設需求延續、資料中心與雲端服務投資增加，以及全球供應鏈分散布局趨勢下，2026 年泰國 PCB 產值將進一步成長至 60.9 億美元，年增 20.4%。
泰國盤谷銀行董事資深執行副總裁谷塞浦達昆指出，泰國目前已居全球 PCB 產值前 5 名，在各方大力投資之下，預估很快將進入全球前 3 名。
paras_en: Tenghui Electronics-KY (6672-TW), a CCL (copper foil substrate) electronic materials manufacturer, held the opening ceremony today (26th) for its new plant in the Hi-Tech Industrial Park of Ayutthaya Province, Thailand, officially launching the group’s first production base in Southeast Asia. In line with the global supply‑chain restructuring and the development of AI high‑performance computing, data‑center and other emerging applications, Tenghui is simultaneously advancing further capacity construction at the Thailand site and a NT$1.5‑billion expansion project in Kunshan, China, to further strengthen its global manufacturing footprint, supply‑chain resilience and high‑end material competitiveness.

The opening ceremony of Tenghui Electronics‑KY’s Thailand plant was co‑hosted by Chairman Wang You‑ci, CEO Zhong Jian‑ren, Director Qiu Yi‑cheng and Deputy General Manager Wang Zhu. The highest provincial official of Ayutthaya, Governor Chawanin Wongsattjirakan, attended with a core local leadership team, jointly witnessing this key milestone in the group’s global strategic layout.

The Thailand plant occupies about 35,000 square metres and mainly produces copper‑foil substrates and adhesive sheets. Small‑scale shipments have already begun, with full‑scale mass production slated for the end of 2026. Subsequent adhesive‑coating capacity will be rolled out throughout 2027, raising the plant’s total design capacity by roughly 15%. The new facility implements the “China+1” strategy, serving existing automotive‑electronics customers while also positioning for future data‑center and high‑end electronic material demand.

Tenghui Electronics‑KY noted that, in response to AI, high‑performance computing and data‑center market growth, the board approved a NT$1.5‑billion expansion budget for Kunshan on September 17, with mass production expected to start in Q2 2027. By combining the dual‑base layout in Thailand and Kunshan, the group will further enhance global capacity‑allocation flexibility and strengthen supply capabilities for international customers.

The company emphasized its long‑term focus on a niche market of low‑volume, highly customized special electronic materials. Going forward, it will continue to leverage its technology and product differentiation to actively expand into high‑value‑add applications such as automotive electronics, thermal management materials, ultra‑high‑frequency radar, aerospace‑defense and AI high‑performance computing.

CEO Zhong Jian‑ren said the commissioning of the Thailand plant is a major milestone in Tenghui’s global development and a concrete demonstration of the company’s long‑term commitment to international customers. Facing global supply‑chain reshuffling and rapid advances in next‑generation electronic technologies, Tenghui will keep creating higher value for customers through technological innovation, specialty materials and flexible production capacity, while seizing growth opportunities in AI, high‑performance computing and high‑value‑add electronic materials.

Through the launch of the Thailand plant and the simultaneous Kunshan expansion, Tenghui‑KY will continue to perfect its global manufacturing and supply system, deepen cooperation with international customers, and inject new momentum into the group’s long‑term growth.

The Taiwan Printed Circuit Board Association (TPCA) forecasts that the overall development outlook for 2026 will be markedly better than the past two years, with total domestic and overseas output expected to break the trillion‑NTD mark for the first time, reaching NT$1.1365 trillion, a 24.2% year‑over‑year increase. At the same time, major PCB players such as Wistron (2313‑TW), Kingboard (2368‑TW), Unimicron (3037‑TW), Zhen Ding‑KY (4958‑TW), Jing Peng (2355‑TW) and Ding Ying (3715‑TW) are all heavily investing in Thailand. CCL’s Lianmao (6213‑TW), Tenghui Electronics and Tai Yao (6274‑TW) have already set up production facilities in Thailand, while Tai Guang Electronics (2383‑TW) has established a plant in Malaysia.

Thailand is currently the largest PCB manufacturing hub in Southeast Asia. In 2025, PCB output there reached US$5.06 billion, up 22.4% year‑on‑year, accounting for about 5.4% of global output. Growth is driven mainly by new capacity from Taiwanese and Chinese investors, boosting the share of high‑end applications such as AI servers, high‑speed networking and satellite communications produced in Thailand. It is projected that, with continued AI infrastructure demand, increased data‑center and cloud‑service investments, and the trend toward diversified global supply chains, Thailand’s PCB output will rise to US$6.09 billion in 2026, a 20.4% annual increase.

Senior Executive Vice President Gu Sepu Dakuan of Thailand’s Bank of Ayutthaya said Thailand now ranks among the top five PCB producers worldwide and, with strong investment from all sides, is expected to soon enter the global top three.

items.title: iPhone Duo剛開賣就出問題！螢幕爆裂痕、軟體相容挨批、價格跌破原價
items.title_en: iPhone Duo Hits Trouble Right After Launch: Screen Cracks, Software Compatibility Criticized, Prices Slip Below List Price
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 首款摺疊手機 iPhone Duo 於 10 月 23 日正式開賣，但上市才短短數日，就有首批用戶回報內螢幕沿摺疊處開裂、出現亮線等問題。與此同時，第三方通路已出現低於官方定價的報價，軟體相容也未盡理想，讓這款備受期待的新機面臨硬體可靠性、價格與使用體驗等多重考驗。
據多家外媒報導，部分 iPhone Duo 用戶表示，手機在正常開合過程中就發生螢幕故障。一名澳洲用戶指出，手機到手約 6 小時、開合不到 20 次，內螢幕便沿著摺疊位置裂開。
該用戶表示，當時正準備向朋友展示手機的摺疊功能，展開過程中先感覺鉸鏈內部出現異常，隨後聽到明顯的碎裂聲，螢幕也隨即受損。他強調，手機此前沒有遭受撞擊或擠壓，螢幕表面與外部鉸鏈也未見明顯損傷。事後前往 Apple Store 反映，蘋果直接為他更換新機。
類似情況也有其他用戶回報。有中國用戶表示，正常展開手機時，螢幕摺疊處突然出現約 3 公分長的黑色裂紋，並伴隨橫向亮線。目前曝光的案例中，故障位置多集中在內螢幕中央、靠近鉸鏈的區域，部分裝置還出現橫向亮線。
知名維修機構 iFixit 近期拆解 iPhone Duo 後發現，機身內部採用複雜的齒輪、彈簧及金屬連接結構，透過特殊設計控制柔性螢幕在開合時承受的力量。
拆解分析也提出一種可能性：若鉸鏈內部的中央支撐結構未能正常回縮，或活動零件發生位置偏移，就可能對螢幕施加額外壓力，進而造成顯示面板損壞。
不過，這目前仍只是根據拆解結果提出的技術推測，尚無法確認螢幕故障究竟源自個別零件缺陷、組裝問題，還是整體結構設計。

第三方通路價格跌破官方定價　黃牛轉售空間受壓

除了硬體問題，iPhone Duo 的市場價格也開始鬆動。
此前，蘋果官網一度顯示交貨時間延長至 2027 年 1 月，部分消費者與黃牛原本期待藉由首批貨源短缺賺取轉售價差。不過，隨著第三方通路陸續供貨，部分中國電商平台已出現優惠後人民幣 15,099 元的報價，較官方 15,999 人民幣起售價低 900 人民幣。
但這類優惠通常需要搶購限量優惠券，並非所有消費者都能以該價格購買。部分商家還要求買家當面簽收並完成開機啟用，啟用後不接受七天無理由退貨。
另一方面，抖音電商平台上的蘋果授權專營店也已開放下單。其中，256GB 版本售價為人民幣 15,999 元，與蘋果官方定價相同，商品頁面並標示付款後隔日出貨。
第三方通路開始提供正常購買管道，意味著消費者不必完全仰賴首批稀缺貨源，也讓原本期待加價轉售的黃牛面臨更大壓力。

軟體相容不如預期　蘋果自家 App 也未充分利用大螢幕

硬體故障與價格變化之外，iPhone Duo 的軟體相容同樣引發討論。部分應用程式即使在手機展開後，仍維持傳統 iPhone 的介面比例，未能充分利用更大的顯示空間。
蘋果自家的 Apple Store 購物 App 就出現這類問題。手機展開後，應用程式仍以傳統手機的直向比例顯示，周圍留下大片黑色區域；即使手動調整視窗大小，內容也沒有重新配置版面。
相較之下，特斯拉(TSLA-US) App 在 iPhone Duo 開賣前便推出更新，針對 iPad 與摺疊手機等大螢幕裝置調整介面。手機展開並橫向使用時，畫面可採類似平板的寬螢幕布局，左側呈現車輛資訊、充電、升級及服務等功能，右側則顯示較大幅度的車輛 3D 模型。
不過，特斯拉 App 也並非所有頁面都已完善，首批測試中，車輛 3D 展示頁面出現無法拖動的問題，個人頁面的相容表現也仍有改善空間。
在中國市場，微信的相容更是用戶關注的焦點。iPhone Duo 剛上市時，微信聊天畫面仍以傳統手機比例置中顯示，兩側留下大片黑邊。
之後微信推出 8.0.80 版本，開始支援展開後的左右分欄布局，左側顯示聊天列表，右側呈現對話內容，但整體設計仍被認為較為生硬，部分黑邊、手勢操作及工具列位置也有待調整。
微信朋友圈則仍維持單欄資訊流，沒有針對摺疊大螢幕重新設計。至於公眾號文章頁面，原有的帳號資訊及按讚、轉發、收藏、評論等操作，也還有重新配置的空間。
此外，微信於 10 月 24 日進一步開放與其他手機同時登入的功能，部分 iPhone Duo 用戶已能選擇讓摺疊手機與另一台手機共用同一個微信帳號。不過，該功能目前仍採灰度開放，並非所有用戶都能使用。
其他熱門 App 的表現也不一致。抖音展開後仍維持傳統手機的直向畫面，周圍留下大片黑邊，雖然影片能正常播放，但未充分利用大螢幕。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) launched its first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, on October 23. Within just a few days of release, early users reported internal screen cracks and bright lines along the fold. At the same time, third‑party channels began offering prices below Apple’s official list, and software compatibility fell short, putting the highly anticipated device under pressure for hardware reliability, pricing and user experience.

According to multiple foreign media outlets, some iPhone Duo owners said the screen failed during normal opening and closing. An Australian user noted that after about six hours of use and fewer than 20 folds, the internal screen cracked along the folding line.

The user said he was about to demonstrate the folding feature to a friend when he felt an abnormality inside the hinge, heard a distinct shattering sound, and saw the screen damage immediately. He emphasized that the phone had not been dropped or squeezed, and the screen surface and outer hinge showed no obvious damage. He later visited an Apple Store, where Apple replaced the device with a new one.

Similar reports came from other users. A Chinese user said that while opening the phone normally, a roughly 3‑centimeter black crack appeared at the fold, accompanied by a horizontal bright line. In the cases disclosed so far, failures tend to cluster in the center of the internal screen near the hinge, with some devices also showing horizontal bright lines.

Well‑known repair firm iFixit recently disassembled the iPhone Duo and found a complex internal structure of gears, springs and metal connections designed to control the forces on the flexible display during opening and closing.

The teardown analysis suggested a possible cause: if the central support inside the hinge fails to retract properly or moving parts shift out of position, extra pressure could be applied to the screen, leading to panel damage.

However, this remains a technical hypothesis based on the teardown; it has not been confirmed whether the screen failures stem from a specific component defect, an assembly issue, or the overall structural design.
Third‑party channel prices have fallen below Apple’s list price, squeezing scalpers’ resale margins.

Earlier, Apple’s website showed delivery dates pushed back to January 2027, and some consumers and scalpers hoped to profit from the shortage of the first batch. As third‑party channels gradually stocked the phone, some Chinese e‑commerce platforms listed the device for 15,099 CNY after discounts, about 900 CNY lower than Apple’s starting price of 15,999 CNY.

These discounted offers usually require snapping up limited‑quantity coupons, so not every consumer can buy at that price. Some sellers also require in‑person receipt and device activation, and they do not accept seven‑day no‑reason returns after activation.

Meanwhile, Apple‑authorized stores on the Douyin e‑commerce platform have opened for orders. The 256 GB model is priced at 15,999 CNY, matching Apple’s official price, and the product page states that it ships the next day after payment.

The emergence of normal purchase channels through third‑party sellers means consumers no longer have to rely solely on the scarce first‑batch stock, putting additional pressure on scalpers who hoped to flip the device at a premium.
Software compatibility has also drawn criticism. Some apps still use the traditional iPhone aspect ratio even after the phone is unfolded, failing to take full advantage of the larger display.

Apple’s own Apple Store shopping app exhibits this issue. After unfolding, the app still displays in the portrait ratio of a regular phone, leaving large black bars on the sides; even manually resizing the window does not re‑layout the content.

In contrast, Tesla’s (TSLA-US) app released an update before the iPhone Duo launch that adapts its interface for large‑screen devices such as iPads and foldables. When the phone is unfolded and used in landscape, the app adopts a tablet‑like wide layout, with vehicle info, charging, upgrades and services on the left and a larger 3‑D vehicle model on the right.
However, the Tesla app is not perfect; during early testing, the 3‑D vehicle display page could not be dragged, and the personal‑page compatibility still has room for improvement.

In China, WeChat’s compatibility is a particular focus for users. When the iPhone Duo first launched, WeChat’s chat screen remained centered in the traditional phone aspect ratio, leaving large black borders on both sides.

WeChat later released version 8.0.80, adding support for a split‑screen layout after unfolding: the chat list appears on the left and the conversation on the right. The overall design is still considered somewhat clunky, with remaining black borders, gesture handling and toolbar placement needing tweaks.

WeChat Moments still uses a single‑column feed and has not been redesigned for the foldable’s larger screen. Public‑account article pages also retain the original account info and like, share, bookmark and comment controls, leaving space for re‑layout.

On October 24, WeChat further opened a feature allowing simultaneous login on another phone, enabling some iPhone Duo users to share a WeChat account with a second device. The feature is currently in a gray‑scale rollout and not available to all users.

Performance of other popular apps is also inconsistent. Douyin, when unfolded, still shows a traditional portrait view with large black borders; videos play normally but the large screen is not fully utilized.

items.title: AI資料中心成美國大選最新政治炸彈！川普力挺建設、州級暫停令機率升至27%
items.title_en: AI Data Centers Become the Latest Political Bomb in the U.S. Election! Trump Backs Construction, Statewide Pause Probability Rises to 27%
paras: 儘管美國資料中心建設面臨日益升高的地方反對聲浪，美國總統川普仍持續為相關基礎設施發聲，並提出由業者與社區分享經濟利益、要求大型新建資料中心自行發電等構想，希望降低居民疑慮。然而，民意反彈、地方停工措施與政治壓力仍持續發酵，資料中心擴建也逐漸成為美國政治議題。
預測市場平台 Polymarket 發文指出，川普敦促美國各地社區冷靜看待資料中心建設。該平台當時顯示，今年底前至少有一個州通過全州適用的資料中心暫停立法，機率約為27%。
根據合約規則，只要有任何一州在12月31日前通過相關立法，該合約便以「是」結算；10月24日市場報價約為28%。

川普提議分享收益　資料中心建設仍遭地方反對

川普一直支持擴建資料中心。8月底，他曾在社群平台表示，社區反對資料中心的原因，是不願進步、希望維持貧窮，並稱中國樂見美國反資料中心運動持續發展。
到了10月21日，川普轉而提出利益分享方案，建議資料中心業者向所在地社區或居民支付分紅。他也要求新建大型資料中心自行供電，並將多餘電力回售給社區，認為此舉不僅能避免電價上漲，甚至可能大幅降低電費。
白宮7月底宣布，已有超過200家電力公司、州政府與開發商加入川普提出的電費保護承諾，涵蓋全美約八成居民用電。
不過，民意調查顯示，資料中心選址仍面臨顯著阻力。《ABC》、《華盛頓郵報》與Ipsos聯合民調指出，72%的美國受訪者反對在自家附近興建資料中心，農村地區的反對比例更達78%。
資料中心議題也逐漸進入選舉攻防。部分民主黨人將地方反對聲浪視為競選議題，共和黨內也有候選人與川普的立場拉開距離。密西根州參議員候選人羅傑斯（Mike Rogers）便公開支持暫停建設。
紐約州州長霍楚（Kathy Hochul）已發布全州首個資料中心開發暫停令。研究機構22V Research則預測，支持資料中心建設的州可能從27個減少至約15個。

業者祭出現金回饋　仍難平息居民疑慮

面對地方阻力，川普主張讓社區直接分享資料中心帶來的經濟利益。他表示，部分原本不受歡迎的資料中心計畫，在業者與地方達成財務協議後，便獲得更多支持。
部分開發商已採取類似做法。密蘇里州開發商NorthPoint曾承諾，若資料中心建成投用，將向賓州Hazle鎮每戶家庭支付1萬美元。
但金錢補償並未消除所有反對意見。Hazle鎮居民最終取得法院停工令；馬里蘭州弗雷德里克縣一項價值1.1億美元的社區回饋方案，也遭縣長否決，當地暫停令的期限反而延長至2027年7月。
部分居民更質疑，以現金換取地方支持並非解決問題的適當方式。一名退休居民接受法新社訪問時，便將這類安排形容為賄賂。
資料中心建設的爭議，因而不只涉及開發商願意提供多少補償，也包括地方居民是否接受相關建設，以及電力供應與社區利益能否獲得保障。
美國期中選舉將於11月3日舉行，資料中心建設已成為選舉期間受到關注的議題。隨著地方反對聲浪、州級暫停措施與業者補償方案持續交錯，後續政策走向仍將影響美國資料中心的擴建進程。
paras_en: Despite growing local opposition to data‑center construction in the United States, President Trump continues to champion the related infrastructure, proposing ideas such as sharing economic benefits with operators and communities and requiring large new data centers to generate their own power, in hopes of easing residents' concerns. Nevertheless, public backlash, local shutdown measures and political pressure keep mounting, and data‑center expansion is gradually turning into a political issue in the U.S.

The prediction market platform Polymarket posted that Trump is urging communities across the country to view data‑center construction calmly. The platform at the time indicated that there is about a 27% chance that at least one state will pass statewide legislation to pause data‑center projects before the end of the year.
According to the contract rules, if any state passes the relevant legislation by December 31, the contract settles as "yes"; on October 24 the market price was roughly 28%.

Trump proposes profit‑sharing; data‑center construction still faces local opposition. Trump has long supported expanding data centers. At the end of August he said on social media that communities oppose data centers because they are unwilling to progress and want to stay poor, adding that China welcomes the continued development of the anti‑data‑center movement in the United States.

By October 21, Trump shifted to a profit‑sharing proposal, suggesting that data‑center operators pay dividends to the host community or residents. He also demanded that new large data centers generate their own electricity and sell any surplus back to the community, arguing that this would not only prevent electricity price hikes but could dramatically lower power bills.

The White House announced in late July that more than 200 power companies, state governments and developers have joined Trump's electricity‑protection pledge, covering roughly 80% of U.S. residential electricity consumption.

However, polls show that locating data centers still faces significant resistance. A joint poll by ABC, The Washington Post and Ipsos found that 72% of American respondents oppose building a data center near their homes, with opposition in rural areas climbing to 78%.

The data‑center issue is also creeping into election battles. Some Democrats are treating local opposition as a campaign theme, while within the Republican Party some candidates are distancing themselves from Trump’s stance. Michigan Senate candidate Mike Rogers publicly supported pausing construction.

New York Governor Kathy Hochul has issued the state's first data‑center development moratorium. Research firm 22V Research predicts that the number of states supporting data‑center construction could drop from 27 to about 15.

Operators offer cash rebates but still struggle to calm resident concerns. Facing local resistance, Trump argues that communities should directly share the economic benefits of data centers. He says that some previously unpopular data‑center projects gained more support after operators reached financial agreements with localities.
Some developers have already adopted similar tactics. Missouri developer NorthPoint pledged to pay $10,000 per household in Hazle, Pennsylvania, if the data center is built and put into operation.

But monetary compensation has not eliminated all opposition. Hazle residents ultimately secured a court‑ordered shutdown; a $110 million community‑benefit plan in Frederick County, Maryland, was vetoed by the county executive, and the local moratorium was extended instead, now running until July 2027.
Some residents further question whether paying cash for local support is an appropriate solution. A retired resident interviewed by AFP described such arrangements as bribery.

The controversy over data‑center construction therefore involves not only how much compensation developers are willing to provide, but also whether local residents accept the projects and whether power supply and community benefits can be guaranteed.

The U.S. midterm elections will be held on November 3, and data‑center construction has become a topic of attention during the campaign. As local opposition, state‑level moratoria and developer compensation schemes continue to intersect, the policy direction that follows will still shape the pace of data‑center expansion in the United States.

items.title: 塞爾維亞議會選舉變天？武契奇坦言恐落敗、學生陣營宣布勝選
items.title_en: Serbian Parliamentary Election Upset? Vučić Admits Fear of Defeat, Student Bloc Claims Victory
paras: 塞爾維亞前總統武契奇（Aleksandar Vučić）週日（25日）晚間表示，根據分層抽樣統計結果，由他領銜的「亞歷山大·武契奇－團結的塞爾維亞」參選名單，可能在當天舉行的提前議會選舉中落敗。他預測，由學生組成的「學生名單－學生獲勝」有望取得國民議會過半席次。
武契奇當晚在塞爾維亞前進黨競選總部發表談話指出，儘管官方尚未公布最終選舉結果，但現有統計已顯示，他所領導的參選名單未能勝出。與此同時，「學生名單-學生獲勝」25日亦宣布，在當天舉行的議會選舉中獲勝。
他預估，「學生名單－學生獲勝」將取得國民議會250個席次中的135至140席，而他領銜的參選名單則可能獲得約105席。
不過，塞爾維亞共和國選舉委員會稍早公布的首批初步計票數據，與武契奇的預測有所不同。
根據已完成統計的203個投票站數據，「亞歷山大·武契奇－團結的塞爾維亞」參選名單得票率為54.69%，「學生名單－學生獲勝」則為36.04%。
然而，由於當時納入統計的投票站數量有限，這批數據尚不足以反映全國整體選情。
此次塞爾維亞提前議會選舉於當地時間25日上午7時開始投票，晚間8時結束。全國登記選民超過645萬人，共有18份參選名單、2,418名候選人角逐國民議會250個席次。
目前選舉結果仍未定案，最終席次分配有待塞爾維亞共和國選舉委員會正式公布。
武契奇此前獲塞爾維亞前進黨推舉，擔任該黨國會選舉名單領銜人及總理候選人。他於9月9日簽署解散國會的總統令，宣布提前於10月25日舉行議會選舉，並於9月27日卸下總統職務。
武契奇於2017年4月當選總統，並在2022年5月成功連任。根據塞爾維亞憲法，總統任期為5年，最多只能連任一次。在出任總統之前，他曾於2012年擔任第一副總理，並於2014年出任總理。
塞爾維亞官方數據顯示，該國失業率已從2012年的約24%降至2025年的約9%，以歐元計算的名目國內生產毛額（GDP）也增至2012年的兩倍以上。2024年，塞爾維亞吸引外國直接投資約52億歐元，創下歷史新高。
與傳統政黨組成的選舉名單相比，「學生名單－學生獲勝」的成員背景更加多元，涵蓋醫師、大學教授、演員、運動員及金融業從業人員等不同領域。
波蘭東方研究中心研究員諾維諾夫斯基指出，學生團體提出的反貪腐等主張具有廣泛的社會動員力，但其整體施政方向仍不夠明確，尚缺乏完整的改革方案、具體執行路徑及推動時程規劃。
本次選舉共有18份選舉名單、2,418名候選人參與角逐，當選者將組成新一屆國民議會。參選陣營包括由塞爾維亞前進黨主導的「亞歷山大·武契奇－團結的塞爾維亞」、學生團體推動的「學生名單－學生獲勝」，以及由塞爾維亞社會黨等政黨組成的「伊維察·達契奇－穩定的力量！」等。
塞爾維亞議會選舉採比例代表制，選民投票支持政黨或政黨聯盟提出的名單，國民議會再依各名單的得票比例分配250個席次。除少數族裔選舉名單外，一般名單須取得至少3%的總票數，才能參與議席分配。
paras_en: Former Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić said on Sunday evening (the 25th) that, based on stratified sampling statistics, the list he leads, "Aleksandar Vučić – United Serbia," could lose in the early parliamentary election scheduled for that day. He predicted that the student‑led "Student List – Students Win" is likely to secure a majority of seats in the National Assembly.

Vučić spoke at the Serbian Progressive Party campaign headquarters that night, noting that although the official final results have not yet been released, the existing statistics already show his list failed to win. At the same time, the "Student List – Students Win" announced on the 25th that it had won the parliamentary election that day.
He estimated the "Student List – Students Win" would obtain 135 to 140 of the 250 seats in the National Assembly, while his own list might receive about 105 seats.
However, the first batch of preliminary vote counts released earlier by the Republic Election Commission differed from Vučić’s forecast.
Based on data from 203 polling stations that have been processed, the "Aleksandar Vučić – United Serbia" list recorded a vote share of 54.69%, while the "Student List – Students Win" earned 36.04%.
Because the number of polling stations included in the count was limited at the time, these figures are not sufficient to reflect the nationwide voting trend.

The early parliamentary election in Serbia began at 7 a.m. local time on the 25th and ended at 8 p.m. that evening. More than 6.45 million voters were registered nationwide, with 18 electoral lists and 2,418 candidates contesting the 250 seats in the National Assembly.
The election outcome remains undecided, and the final seat allocation will await formal publication by the Republic Election Commission.

Vučić was previously nominated by the Serbian Progressive Party as the lead candidate on its parliamentary list and as the prime‑ministerial candidate. He signed a presidential decree on September 9 dissolving parliament and calling an early election for October 25, and he stepped down from the presidency on September 27.

Vučić was first elected president in April 2017 and was re‑elected in May 2022. Under the Serbian constitution, the presidential term is five years and may be renewed only once. Before becoming president, he served as first deputy prime minister in 2012 and became prime minister in 2014.

Official Serbian data show that the unemployment rate has fallen from about 24 % in 2012 to roughly 9 % in 2025, and nominal GDP measured in euros has more than doubled since 2012. In 2024, Serbia attracted about €5.2 billion in foreign direct investment, a historic high.
Compared with traditional party‑based lists, the "Student List – Students Win" features a more diverse roster, including doctors, university professors, actors, athletes and finance professionals.

Researcher Novinowski of the Polish Centre for Eastern Studies noted that the student group’s anti‑corruption platform has broad mobilising power, but its overall policy direction remains vague, lacking a complete reform programme, concrete implementation pathways and a timeline for action.

A total of 18 electoral lists and 2,418 candidates took part in the election, with the winners forming the new National Assembly. The competing camps include the Serbian Progressive Party‑led "Aleksandar Vučić – United Serbia," the student‑driven "Student List – Students Win," and coalitions such as "Ivica Dačić – Stable Force!" formed by the Serbian Social Party and others.

Serbian parliamentary elections use a proportional‑representation system: voters cast ballots for parties or party alliances, and seats in the 250‑member National Assembly are allocated according to each list’s share of the vote. Except for minority lists, a general list must obtain at least 3 % of the total vote to qualify for seat distribution.

items.title: 大規模草原火災 蒙古：考慮向涉事日本企業索賠
items.title_en: Massive Grassland Fire in Mongolia: Government Considers Claim Against Involved Japanese Firm
paras: 本月初日本電信公司凱迪迪愛公司在蒙古國自然保護區的活動引發大規模草原火災，蒙古國政府24日（周六）召開內閣會議，表示將通過調查確定相關責任方，並考慮向引發火災的日本企業索賠。
蒙古國副總理諾木泰巴亞爾表示，僅僅道歉是不夠的，有必要就這起火災向相關責任方索賠。
此前，蒙古國司法與內務部長特穆倫說，火災調查正在推進，草原火災責任人賠償。
蒙古國東方省努姆魯格自然保護區8日發生大規模草原火災。受強風助推，再加上乾旱天氣加劇火情，火勢迅速向中國內蒙古方向蔓延。中方調集包括消防員、地方應急隊伍在內共3,400名人員，展開跨境火災撲救工作。
據《觀察者網》26日報導，最終這場大火於16日被撲滅，努姆魯格自然保護區約80%區域被焚毀。
火災發生前，凱迪迪愛公司控股的蒙古國電信公司莫比康的日籍高層身處保護區內，他們乘坐5輛汽車進入保護區，車輛在行駛過程中引燃乾草，釀成草原火災。但凱迪迪愛公司直至20日才承認，火災與子公司高層活動有關。
當地時間10月23日，凱迪迪愛公司在官方網站上公開致歉，表示將全力配合蒙古國方面的調查，但堅稱涉事人員「不存在違法行為」。
paras_en: Earlier this month, Japan's telecommunications firm KDDI (KDDI Corp.) caused a massive grassland fire while operating in a Mongolian nature reserve, prompting the Mongolian government to hold a cabinet meeting on Saturday the 24th and announce that it will investigate to identify responsible parties and consider filing a claim against the Japanese company that sparked the blaze.
Mongolia's Deputy Prime Minister Nominbayar said that a simple apology is insufficient and that compensation must be sought from those responsible for the fire.

Previously, Mongolia's Minister of Justice and Internal Affairs Temurlen noted that the fire investigation is underway and that those liable for the grassland fire will be required to pay compensation.

On the 8th, a large grassland fire broke out in the Numrug Nature Reserve in Mongolia's Eastern Province. Strong winds and drought conditions accelerated the blaze, which quickly spread toward China's Inner Mongolia. Chinese authorities mobilized a total of 3,400 personnel, including firefighters and local emergency teams, to conduct cross‑border fire‑fighting operations.
According to the Observer website on the 26th, the fire was finally extinguished on the 16th, after roughly 80% of the Numrug Nature Reserve had been burned.

Before the fire, senior Japanese executives of Mobicom, a Mongolian telecom company owned by KDDI, were inside the reserve. They entered in five cars, and the vehicles ignited dry grass during the drive, causing the grassland fire. KDDI did not acknowledge the link between the fire and its subsidiary’s executives until the 20th.

On October 23 local time, KDDI posted a public apology on its website, stating it would fully cooperate with Mongolian authorities' investigation while insisting that the personnel involved “did not commit any illegal acts.”

items.title: 銘福開發與大馬Naza集團簽MOU 合攻城市採礦商機
items.title_en: Mingfu Development Signs MOU with Malaysia's Naza Group to Jointly Pursue Urban Mining Opportunities
paras: 旗下控有包括金聯成(7865-TW)等逾30家企業的銘福集團，在海外事業布局跨出重要一大步，銘福集團旗下的銘福開發今(26)日與與馬來西亞Naza集團旗下Naza Enviro控股簽署合作備忘錄(MOU)，雙方將就馬國當地環保產業園區的城市採礦商機，進行研議技術及營運合作。
在此一台灣銘福開發與大馬知名的回收控股企業的合作規劃中，未來再進一步延伸至電池回收等領域。
今天簽約典禮由合作雙方高層出席，包含銘福集團創辦人兼董事長陳福松、副董事長陳奕潔、成功集團創辦人陳志遠等受邀出席。
銘福集團指出，隨著馬來西亞汽車市場持續成長，報廢車輛（ELVs）與廢棄車輛的處置已成重要課題，馬來西亞政府正積極透過環境部（DOE）與道路運輸部（JPJ）完善相關監管法規，重塑馬來西亞廢棄車輛的處置模式，致力打造兼具高標準有害廢棄物處理、廢液抽取與高價值材料回收的全方位現代化園區。
Naza Enviro是馬來西亞知名的回收控股，為當地各級提供市政服務。據統計，馬來西亞一年新車銷售逾80萬輛，其中電動車銷售銷量顯著增加，隨著當地汽車使用與電動化持續發展，雙方合作發潛力備受看好。
銘福集團50年來在台灣從事報廢車輛拆解、金屬回收及再生材料處理。這次雙方選定的馬來西亞BTEP環保園區，目前已有廢棄物處理、水處理、掩埋氣發電等設施，雙方合作將從報廢車輛的前端去污染、拆解分類及後端材料回收著手，結合銘福專業的處理實績，及Naza Enviro的環境管理與園區營運能力，研議適合當地的業務合作方案。
銘福集團副董事長陳奕潔表示，銘福在台灣實績有目共睹，但不同國家市場仍要從當地法規、車輛來源和處理需求出發，未來與進一步Naza集團洽談鉛酸蓄電池、鋰電池回收、再生材料處理等領域合作。銘福集團旗下金聯成、名仁資源的專業實力，將提供後續合作的堅強基礎。
paras_en: Mingfu Group, which controls more than 30 companies including Jin Lian Cheng (7865‑TW), has taken a major step in its overseas expansion. Today (the 26th), Mingfu Development, a subsidiary of Mingfu Group, signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Naza Enviro Holdings, a unit of Malaysia's Naza Group. The two parties will explore technical and operational cooperation on urban mining opportunities in an environmental industrial park in Malaysia.
Under this cooperation plan between Taiwan's Mingfu Development and the well‑known Malaysian recycling holding company, the partnership may later extend to battery recycling and related fields.

The signing ceremony was attended by senior executives from both sides, including Mingfu Group founder and chairman Chen Fu‑song, vice chairman Chen Yi‑jie, and Cheng Chih‑yuan, founder of Cheng‑gong Group, who were invited to the event.

Mingfu Group noted that as Malaysia's automobile market continues to grow, the disposal of end‑of‑life vehicles (ELVs) and waste vehicles has become a critical issue. The Malaysian government is actively strengthening related regulatory frameworks through the Department of Environment (DOE) and the Road Transport Department (JPJ) to reshape the country's vehicle waste disposal model, aiming to build a modern, comprehensive park that meets high standards for hazardous waste treatment, fluid extraction, and high‑value material recovery.

Naza Enviro is a well‑known Malaysian recycling holding company that provides municipal services at all levels. Statistics show that Malaysia sells over 800,000 new cars annually, with electric‑vehicle sales rising sharply. As local vehicle usage and electrification continue to develop, the potential of the partnership is viewed very positively.

Mingfu Group has spent 50 years in Taiwan dismantling end‑of‑life vehicles, recycling metals and processing recycled materials. The Malaysian BTEP environmental park selected for this cooperation already has facilities for waste treatment, water treatment and landfill gas power generation. The collaboration will address pollution control, dismantling and sorting at the front end of ELVs and material recovery at the back end, combining Mingfu's proven processing expertise with Naza Enviro's environmental management and park‑operating capabilities to devise a business model suited to the local market.

Vice chairman Chen Yi‑jie said that Mingfu's achievements in Taiwan are evident, but each foreign market must start from local regulations, vehicle sources and processing needs. Future talks with Naza Group will explore cooperation in lead‑acid battery, lithium‑ion battery recycling and recycled material processing. The professional strengths of Mingfu’s subsidiaries Jin Lian Cheng and Ming‑ren Resources will provide a solid foundation for subsequent collaboration.

items.title: 外資狂賣3025億元台股不妙？野村估明年EPS成長29% 科技ETF展韌性
items.title_en: Foreign Investors Dump NT$302.5 B of Taiwan Stocks – Is a Market Slump Coming? Nomura Forecasts 29% EPS Growth in 2027, Tech ETFs Show Resilience
paras: 美國消費者物價指數高於市場預期引發升息疑慮，外資單日大舉賣超台股高達3025.55億元，創歷史紀錄，此外，薔琵颱風讓台股多休市一天，市場憂心本周調節與避險壓力湧現。野村投信指出，回顧歷史數據，外資大幅賣超後，台股多能回歸企業獲利與產業基本面。其中科技市值型指數中長期表現亮眼，其內部團隊估2027年企業每股盈餘成長率可達29%，顯示企業獲利能力具備強大支撐力，科技股長線仍具備回歸基本面的潛力。
近期國際總體經濟環境面臨挑戰，美國最新公布的通膨數據高於市場原先預期，使得美國聯準會的升息疑慮再度升溫，直接衝擊全球金融市場情緒。受此負面因素影響，台股日前遭到外資單日狂賣高達3025.55億元，一舉刷新歷史最高賣超紀錄，引發市場高度關注。
為釐清外資大賣後的台股走勢，野村投信針對歷史上外資單日賣超金額前十大事件進行統計分析。數據顯示，觀察後續20個、60個及120個交易日，台股加權指數平均總報酬分別達2.19%、19%與26.7%，呈現隨時間拉長逐步消化賣壓並回升的穩健趨勢。若轉向大型權值股，FTSE台灣50指數同期間平均總報酬分別為2.44%、20.63%及28.98%，皆優於整體加權指數。
若進一步聚焦於創新科技領域，TIP台灣創新科技50指數的漲勢更為突出。其在上述三個期間的平均總報酬分別高達3.68%、32.44%以及40.36%。特別是在120個交易日後，其平均表現更是大幅超越加權指數達13.66個百分點。歷史回測數據顯示，外資大幅調節後，具備產業競爭優勢的科技市值型企業，往往能在市場情緒回穩後展現強勁的反彈力道。
針對近期產業動態，野村台灣新科技50 ETF (00935-TW) 基金經理人林怡君指出，台股受全球利率高檔、人工智慧融資成本攀升及部分AI伺服器訂單遞延影響，短線波動加劇。但全球AI基礎建設的長期投資趨勢並未改變，大型雲端服務供應商依然持續擴大資本支出。隨著新一代Vera Rubin平台預期將於今年第四季末至明年第一季初逐步放量，加上客製化晶片出貨量成長，相關供應鏈明年第一季有望呈現淡季不淡。
根據野村投信內部台股股票池預估，2027年企業每股盈餘成長率大約可達29%，顯示企業獲利能力具備強大支撐力。不過林怡君提醒，在資金成本上升與產業內部競爭加劇的雙重壓力下，未來供應鏈表現可能進一步分化。唯有具備關鍵核心技術、擁有穩定接單能力及維持良好獲利品質的一線企業，才較有機會在激烈市場競爭中維持長期優勢。

隨著人工智慧應用由模型訓練延伸至終端推論，科技產業成長機會正輻射至先進封裝、電子零組件、高速傳輸及散熱等多元領域。林怡君建議，投資科技股應重視研發投入與技術競爭力。以00935追蹤的TIP台灣創新科技50指數為例，其結合FactSet創新科技產業分類，透過研發費用占營收比重、獲利條件、市值及股價動能等指標篩選50家企業。面對市場震盪，投資人可透過科技市值型ETF分散布局次產業，並採分批進場策略穩健掌握中長期發展機會。
paras_en: U.S. consumer price index data came in above market expectations, raising concerns about further rate hikes. Foreign investors sold a record NT$3025.55 billion of Taiwan stocks in a single day, the biggest net outflow ever. In addition, Typhoon Kong‑pi forced a market holiday, prompting worries that the week could see heightened correction and hedging pressure. Nomura Asset Management notes that historically, after large foreign sell‑offs the market tends to revert to corporate earnings and industry fundamentals. The mid‑ to long‑term performance of the technology‑cap weighted index has been especially strong, and its internal team projects a 29% corporate earnings‑per‑share growth rate by 2027, indicating robust profit support and long‑term upside for tech stocks.

The global macro environment has recently become more challenging. The latest U.S. inflation figures were higher than previously expected, reviving concerns that the Federal Reserve may raise rates again, which in turn dampened global market sentiment. As a result, Taiwan’s market experienced a massive single‑day foreign outflow of NT$3025.55 billion, setting a new record and drawing intense market attention.

To clarify how the market behaves after such foreign sell‑offs, Nomura analyzed the ten biggest single‑day foreign net‑sell events in history. Looking at the subsequent 20, 60 and 120 trading‑day windows, the Taiwan Capitalization Weighted Index delivered average total returns of 2.19%, 19% and 26.7% respectively, showing a steady trend of pressure being absorbed and prices rebounding over time. For large‑cap stocks, the FTSE Taiwan 50 Index posted even higher average returns over the same periods – 2.44%, 20.63% and 28.98% – outperforming the broader index.

Focusing on the innovative technology segment, the TIP Taiwan Innovative Technology 50 Index performed even better. Its average total returns over the three windows were 3.68%, 32.44% and 40.36%. Notably, after 120 trading days it outperformed the weighted index by 13.66 percentage points. Historical back‑tests show that after heavy foreign adjustments, technology‑cap companies with competitive advantages tend to rebound strongly once market sentiment stabilises.

Regarding recent industry dynamics, Lin Yi‑jun, portfolio manager of the Nomura Taiwan New Technology 50 ETF (00935‑TW), said that Taiwan’s market is facing heightened short‑term volatility due to high global rates, rising AI financing costs and some delayed AI server orders. However, the long‑term trend of global AI infrastructure investment remains unchanged, and large cloud service providers continue to expand capex. With the next‑generation Vera Rubin platform expected to ramp up from late Q4 2023 into early Q1 2024 and customized chip shipments growing, the supply chain is not expected to see a typical seasonal slowdown in Q1 2024.

Nomura’s internal Taiwan stock pool estimates corporate EPS growth of about 29% by 2027, underscoring strong profit fundamentals. Nonetheless, Lin cautions that rising funding costs and intensified intra‑industry competition could further differentiate supply‑chain performance. Only firms with core technologies, stable order pipelines and solid profit quality are likely to maintain a long‑term edge in a fiercely competitive market.

As AI applications expand from model training to edge inference, growth opportunities spread across advanced packaging, electronic components, high‑speed transmission and thermal solutions. Lin advises investors to focus on R&D spending and technological competitiveness when picking tech stocks. The TIP Taiwan Innovative Technology 50 Index, tracked by 00935, combines FactSet’s tech‑industry classification with filters on R&D intensity, profitability, market cap and price momentum to select 50 companies. In volatile markets, investors can diversify across sub‑sectors via tech‑cap ETFs and use staggered entry strategies to capture medium‑ to long‑term growth.

items.title: CCL廠騰輝電子泰國新廠今開幕 昆山同步投資15億元擴產
items.title_en: CCL's Tenghui Electronics Opens New Factory in Thailand, Simultaneously Expands Production in Kunshan with NT$1.5 Billion Investment
paras: CCL(銅箔基板)電子材料製造商騰輝電子-KY(6672-TW)今(26)日於泰國大城府Hi-Tech工業園區舉行新廠開幕典禮，正式啟用集團在東南亞首座生產基地。配合全球供應鏈重組及AI高算力、資料中心等新興應用發展，騰輝電子同步推進泰國廠後續產能建置及中國昆山15億元擴產計畫，進一步強化全球製造布局、供應鏈韌性與高階材料競爭力。
騰輝電子-KY泰國新廠開幕典禮由騰輝董事長王有慈、執行長鍾健人、董事邱奕誠及集團副總王琢共同主持。大城府最高行政長官—府尹查瓦寧（Chawanin Wongsattjirakan）並率領當地核心首長團隊隆重出席，共同見證集團全球策略布局的重要里程碑。
騰輝電子-KY泰國新廠占地約3.5萬平方公尺，主要生產銅箔基板及黏合片，目前已開始小量出貨，預計2026年底正式量產，後續上膠產能將於2027年陸續開出，屆時泰國廠總設計產能預計再提升15%。新廠將落實China+1策略，除服務既有車用電子客戶外，也為未來資料中心及高階電子材料需求預作布局。
騰輝電子-KY指出，因應AI、高階運算與資料中心市場發展，騰輝-KY已於9月17日經董事會通過15億元昆山擴產預算，預計2027年第二季開始量產。結合泰國與昆山雙基地布局，集團將進一步提升全球產能調度彈性，強化國際客戶供應能力。
騰輝電子-KY指出，公司長期深耕少量多樣、高度客製化的特殊電子材料市場，未來將持續發揮技術與產品差異化優勢，積極拓展車用電子、散熱材料、超高頻雷達、航太國防及AI高算力等高附加價值應用。
騰輝電子-KY執行長鍾健人表示，泰國新廠的啟用，是騰輝全球發展的重要里程碑，也代表騰輝電子-KY對國際客戶長期承諾的具體實踐。面對全球供應鏈重組與新世代電子技術快速發展，騰輝電子-KY將持續透過技術創新、特殊材料及彈性生產能力，為客戶創造更高價值，並積極掌握AI、高階運算與高附加價值電子材料的成長契機。
騰輝電子-KY透過泰國新廠啟用與昆山同步擴產，騰輝-KY將持續完善全球製造與供應體系，深化國際客戶合作，為集團長期成長注入新動能。

台灣印刷電路板協會(TPCA)預估 2026 年整體發展態勢明顯優於過去兩年，全年海內外總產值有望首度破兆，達 1 兆 1,365 億元，年增 24.2%。同時，包括華通(2313-TW)、金像電(2368-TW)、欣興(3037-TW)、臻鼎-KY(4958-TW)及敬鵬(2355-TW)、定穎(3715-TW)等大型 PCB 業者，都積極在泰國持續大力投資。而CCL廠聯茂(6213-TW)、騰輝電子及台燿(6274-TW)都已在泰國設廠生產。台光電(2383-TW)則設廠馬來西亞。

泰國目前為東南亞最大的 PCB 生產基地，2025 年 PCB 產值已達 50.6 億美元，年增 22.4%，占全球產值約 5.4%。其成長動能主要來自台資、陸資廠新產能開出，帶動 AI 伺服器、高速網通與衛星通訊等高階應用在泰國生產比重快速提升。預估在 AI 基礎建設需求延續、資料中心與雲端服務投資增加，以及全球供應鏈分散布局趨勢下，2026 年泰國 PCB 產值將進一步成長至 60.9 億美元，年增 20.4%。
泰國盤谷銀行董事資深執行副總裁谷塞浦達昆指出，泰國目前已居全球 PCB 產值前 5 名，在各方大力投資之下，預估很快將進入全球前 3 名。
paras_en: Tenghui Electronics-KY (6672-TW), a CCL (copper foil substrate) electronic materials manufacturer, held the opening ceremony today (26th) for its new plant in the Hi-Tech Industrial Park of Ayutthaya Province, Thailand, officially launching the group’s first production base in Southeast Asia. In line with the global supply‑chain restructuring and the development of AI high‑performance computing, data‑center and other emerging applications, Tenghui is simultaneously advancing further capacity construction at the Thailand site and a NT$1.5‑billion expansion project in Kunshan, China, to further strengthen its global manufacturing footprint, supply‑chain resilience and high‑end material competitiveness.

The opening ceremony of Tenghui Electronics‑KY’s Thailand plant was co‑hosted by Chairman Wang You‑ci, CEO Zhong Jian‑ren, Director Qiu Yi‑cheng and Deputy General Manager Wang Zhu. The highest provincial official of Ayutthaya, Governor Chawanin Wongsattjirakan, attended with a core local leadership team, jointly witnessing this key milestone in the group’s global strategic layout.

The Thailand plant occupies about 35,000 square metres and mainly produces copper‑foil substrates and adhesive sheets. Small‑scale shipments have already begun, with full‑scale mass production slated for the end of 2026. Subsequent adhesive‑coating capacity will be rolled out throughout 2027, raising the plant’s total design capacity by roughly 15%. The new facility implements the “China+1” strategy, serving existing automotive‑electronics customers while also positioning for future data‑center and high‑end electronic material demand.

Tenghui Electronics‑KY noted that, in response to AI, high‑performance computing and data‑center market growth, the board approved a NT$1.5‑billion expansion budget for Kunshan on September 17, with mass production expected to start in Q2 2027. By combining the dual‑base layout in Thailand and Kunshan, the group will further enhance global capacity‑allocation flexibility and strengthen supply capabilities for international customers.

The company emphasized its long‑term focus on a niche market of low‑volume, highly customized special electronic materials. Going forward, it will continue to leverage its technology and product differentiation to actively expand into high‑value‑add applications such as automotive electronics, thermal management materials, ultra‑high‑frequency radar, aerospace‑defense and AI high‑performance computing.

CEO Zhong Jian‑ren said the commissioning of the Thailand plant is a major milestone in Tenghui’s global development and a concrete demonstration of the company’s long‑term commitment to international customers. Facing global supply‑chain reshuffling and rapid advances in next‑generation electronic technologies, Tenghui will keep creating higher value for customers through technological innovation, specialty materials and flexible production capacity, while seizing growth opportunities in AI, high‑performance computing and high‑value‑add electronic materials.

Through the launch of the Thailand plant and the simultaneous Kunshan expansion, Tenghui‑KY will continue to perfect its global manufacturing and supply system, deepen cooperation with international customers, and inject new momentum into the group’s long‑term growth.

The Taiwan Printed Circuit Board Association (TPCA) forecasts that the overall development outlook for 2026 will be markedly better than the past two years, with total domestic and overseas output expected to break the trillion‑NTD mark for the first time, reaching NT$1.1365 trillion, a 24.2% year‑over‑year increase. At the same time, major PCB players such as Wistron (2313‑TW), Kingboard (2368‑TW), Unimicron (3037‑TW), Zhen Ding‑KY (4958‑TW), Jing Peng (2355‑TW) and Ding Ying (3715‑TW) are all heavily investing in Thailand. CCL’s Lianmao (6213‑TW), Tenghui Electronics and Tai Yao (6274‑TW) have already set up production facilities in Thailand, while Tai Guang Electronics (2383‑TW) has established a plant in Malaysia.

Thailand is currently the largest PCB manufacturing hub in Southeast Asia. In 2025, PCB output there reached US$5.06 billion, up 22.4% year‑on‑year, accounting for about 5.4% of global output. Growth is driven mainly by new capacity from Taiwanese and Chinese investors, boosting the share of high‑end applications such as AI servers, high‑speed networking and satellite communications produced in Thailand. It is projected that, with continued AI infrastructure demand, increased data‑center and cloud‑service investments, and the trend toward diversified global supply chains, Thailand’s PCB output will rise to US$6.09 billion in 2026, a 20.4% annual increase.

Senior Executive Vice President Gu Sepu Dakuan of Thailand’s Bank of Ayutthaya said Thailand now ranks among the top five PCB producers worldwide and, with strong investment from all sides, is expected to soon enter the global top three.

items.title: 蘋果iPhone Duo需求爆發！追加三成訂單  鴻海、台積電、新日興受惠
items.title_en: Apple iPhone Duo Demand Explodes! Apple Adds 30% More Orders; Foxconn, TSMC and Xinri Xing Set to Benefit
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 首款摺疊手機 iPhone Duo 開賣後需求超出預期，供貨短缺促使蘋果要求供應鏈加快生產，並追加三成訂單。隨著今年備貨量預估從原先的 600 萬支上修至 800 萬至 1,000 萬支，鴻海(2317-TW) 、台積電(2330-TW) 及新日興(3376-TW) 等供應鏈廠商可望受惠，鉸鏈產能與整機組裝良率則成為後續出貨能否擴大的關鍵。
iPhone Duo 於 10 月 23 日正式開賣，首日各機型即全數售罄，第二波出貨時間預計延至 2027 年 1 月 22 日。供需失衡也推升二手市場價格，轉售價格一度達 3,068 美元，較最低入手價 2,300 美元高出約 33%，反映市場需求強勁。
隨著銷售表現優於預期，多家市調機構已上修 iPhone Duo 出貨預估，2027 年出貨量更上看 3,300 萬支。
iPhone Duo 開賣後迅速售罄，顯示首波備貨未能滿足市場需求。業界分析，供貨不足除了與消費者需求超出預期有關，也受到組裝良率及零組件產能限制。
蘋果因此要求供應鏈加快生產並追加三成訂單，希望盡快補足供貨缺口。對消費性電子產品而言，上市後的銷售時間與市場滲透速度相當重要，若交貨等待時間過長，可能不利於擴大市占率。
從供應鏈分工來看，鴻海負責 iPhone Duo 整機組裝，核心處理器由台積電代工，攸關摺疊手機開闔與結構設計的鉸鏈零組件，則由鴻海與新日興的合資公司供應，美商安費諾(APH-US) 為第二供應商。
業界指出，目前產能瓶頸主要來自鉸鏈供應受限，加上摺疊手機的整機組裝難度較高，良率改善將是提升出貨量的重要因素。
若良率問題能盡快突破，缺貨狀況將有效緩解，消費者等待週期可望縮短，鴻海、台積電、新日興等供應鏈廠商的業績也將隨之顯著受益。
iPhone Duo 的銷售表現也可能改變全球摺疊手機市場的競爭格局。市調機構預估，蘋果在2027年將拿下全球摺疊機市場約四成佔有率，對三星(005930KS) 的市場主導地位構成直接衝擊。
蘋果加入戰局，也可能促使其他智慧型手機品牌加大摺疊機產品布局，進一步帶動市場關注與產品開發。
分析指出，對供應鏈而言，若摺疊手機需求持續成長，相關零組件與組裝業者將有機會獲得更多訂單。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) ’s first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, has seen demand exceed expectations after launch, prompting a supply shortage that led Apple to ask its supply chain to speed up production and add 30% more orders. With the year‑end inventory forecast raised from the original 6 million units to between 8 million and 10 million units, suppliers such as Foxconn (2317‑TW), TSMC (2330‑TW) and Xinri Xing (3376‑TW) are expected to benefit, while hinge capacity and overall device‑assembly yield will be critical to whether shipments can be further expanded.

The iPhone Duo officially went on sale on October 23, and every model sold out on day one; the second wave of shipments is now slated for January 22, 2027. The supply‑demand imbalance also pushed up second‑hand market prices, with resale prices briefly reaching $3,068—about 33% higher than the lowest purchase price of $2,300—reflecting strong market demand.
Because sales are outperforming expectations, several market‑research firms have raised their iPhone Duo shipment forecasts, with 2027 shipments now projected to reach as high as 33 million units.

The rapid sell‑out of the iPhone Duo after launch shows that the initial stock was insufficient to meet market demand. Industry analysts say the shortage is not only due to higher‑than‑expected consumer demand but also to constraints in assembly yield and component‑capacity limits.

Apple therefore asked its supply chain to accelerate production and add a 30% order increase, hoping to quickly close the supply gap. For consumer electronics, the post‑launch sales window and market‑penetration speed are crucial; overly long delivery waits could hinder market‑share expansion.

In terms of supply‑chain roles, Foxconn handles full‑device assembly of the iPhone Duo, the core processor is fabricated by TSMC, and the hinge components—critical to the foldable phone’s opening and structural design—are supplied by a joint venture between Foxconn and Xinri Xing, with Amphenol (APH-US) serving as a secondary supplier.

Industry sources point out that the current capacity bottleneck mainly stems from limited hinge supply, and because foldable phones are harder to assemble, improving yield will be a key factor in boosting shipment volumes.

If the yield issue can be quickly resolved, the shortage will ease, consumer wait times should shorten, and the earnings of supply‑chain firms such as Foxconn, TSMC and Xinri Xing are expected to improve markedly.

The iPhone Duo’s sales performance could also reshape the competitive landscape of the global foldable‑phone market. Research firms estimate that Apple will capture roughly 40% of the worldwide foldable‑phone market in 2027, delivering a direct hit to Samsung’s (005930KS) market‑leadership position.
Apple’s entry into the foldable segment may also prompt other smartphone brands to expand their foldable‑phone offerings, further driving market attention and product development.
Analysts note that for the supply chain, sustained growth in foldable‑phone demand would give component and assembly manufacturers the opportunity to secure additional orders.

items.title: 鴻海旗下Fii發布責任供應鏈戰略白皮書 提「RISE」藍圖未來5年聚焦四大面向
items.title_en: Foxconn Subsidiary Fii Releases Responsible Supply Chain Strategy White Paper, Unveils "RISE" Blueprint Focusing on Four Key Areas Over the Next Five Years
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)旗下工業富聯Fii(601138-CN)近日發布《責任供應鏈戰略白皮書》，提出RISE責任供應鏈戰略藍圖，將未來五年的核心工作聚焦4大方向、並將「構建責任共贏鏈」列為2030年長程目標的重要一環。
工業富聯表示，RISE戰略涵蓋風險導向的盡責管理、誠信與數位信任、以人為本的實踐，以及地球與環境責任4大方向，共11項ESG議題，涵蓋供應鏈風險、負責任礦產管理、商業道德、人權保障、職業健康安全、氣候行動及循環經濟等面向。
在管理機制上，工業富聯依循經濟合作暨發展組織(OECD)的負責任商業行為盡職調查指南，建立涵蓋管理體系、風險識別與評估、風險管理、追蹤與監督、溝通與報告及補救的六步管理流程，並透過治理架構、管理機制與跨部門合作，推動各項策略落實。
在供應鏈管理方面，工業富聯已梳理22部供應鏈法律要求、160條行業關鍵客戶供應鏈管理要求，並參考10多項國際標準、評級或揭露框架；另完成405家FII重大供應商風險評估，依據OECD框架與ISO標準進行管理體系差距評估及根因分析。
工業富聯強調，將持續與供應商合作，透過建立標準、評估現況、制定行動計畫及開放ESG管理平台課程等方式，提供資源與能力支持，提升供應鏈夥伴的責任管理能力，共同推動責任供應鏈發展。
paras_en: Foxconn (2317‑TW) subsidiary Industrial Fulian (Fii) (601138‑CN) recently released a "Responsible Supply Chain Strategy White Paper," presenting the RISE responsible supply chain strategy blueprint. The core work for the next five years will focus on four major directions, and building a "responsible win‑win chain" is highlighted as a key component of its long‑term goal for 2030.

Industrial Fulian says the RISE strategy covers four pillars—risk‑oriented due diligence, integrity and digital trust, people‑centric practice, and planetary and environmental responsibility—encompassing 11 ESG topics such as supply‑chain risk, responsible mineral management, business ethics, human‑rights protection, occupational health and safety, climate action, and circular economy.

In terms of governance, Industrial Fulian follows the OECD Guidelines for Responsible Business Conduct due diligence, establishing a six‑step management process that includes management system, risk identification and assessment, risk management, monitoring and oversight, communication and reporting, and remediation, and drives implementation through its governance structure, management mechanisms and cross‑departmental collaboration.

Regarding supply‑chain management, the company has mapped 22 supply‑chain legal requirements and 160 key customer supply‑chain management requirements, referenced more than ten international standards, rating or disclosure frameworks, and completed risk assessments for 405 major FII suppliers, conducting gap analyses and root‑cause assessments of management systems against OECD frameworks and ISO standards.

Industrial Fulian emphasizes that it will continue to work with suppliers, providing resources and capability support through establishing standards, assessing current status, developing action plans, and offering ESG management platform courses, to enhance partners' responsible management capabilities and jointly advance responsible supply‑chain development.

items.title: 鴻海、輝達合作DGX SuperPOD應用 AI訓練效能提升2.48倍
items.title_en: Foxconn and NVIDIA Collaborate on DGX SuperPOD to Boost AI Training Performance by 2.48×
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)與輝達(NVIDIA)(NVDA-US)合作，導入NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD及DGX GB200系統，加速自研大型語言模型FoxBrain訓練，1200億參數模型的訓練速度較過去採用H100的方案提升2.48倍，在12天內處理1兆Tokens，進一步強化AI模型訓練能力，推動AI技術導入全球製造據點。
透過NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD搭配NVIDIA Blackwell架構及NVLink交換器，可整合多顆GPU的運算資源，加速大型AI模型訓練。鴻海以此為基礎訓練FoxBrain，並進一步結合工業資料與多模態推理能力，發展視覺語言模型，將AI應用延伸至製造、電動車及智慧城市等領域。
在模型訓練效能方面，鴻海採用DGX SuperPOD訓練1200億參數模型，速度較先前以H100為基礎的解決方案提升2.48倍；此外，透過DGX SuperPOD在12天內處理1兆個Tokens，支援FoxBrain模型持續訓練及多模態能力發展。
除了提升模型訓練效能，鴻海也將AI導入生產管理流程，透過自動化生產排程系統(APS)減少工廠排程工時25%，降低生產規劃的人力負擔。在射出成型製程方面，運用AI最佳化製程設定參數，將製程切換相關工程工作量降低50%，提升生產流程效率。
在產線品質管理方面，鴻海運用AI分析SMT產線問題，已針對超過20項主要缺陷根因進行改善，異常改善率逾90%。透過AI模型分析及即時決策能力，將AI應用延伸至製造現場，協助辨識產線異常原因，並提升問題處理效率。
鴻海也運用NVIDIA Mission Control管理AI運算資源，支援全球超過200個廠區的AI工作負載調度，並結合NVIDIA Run及NIM微服務，提升AI模型部署彈性。此外，鴻海採用NVIDIA RTX PRO伺服器，支援工廠數位孿生模擬及AI代理工作流程，透過NVIDIA Omniverse與Isaac模擬機器人及生產環境，協助產線驗證與複製，加速AI技術導入全球製造據點。
鴻海也將持續與輝達合作，推動AI在智慧製造、智慧電動車及智慧城市等領域的應用，並透過AI Token生態系與開放式代理框架，協助企業發展客製化AI代理，擴大AI技術在產業的應用。
paras_en: Foxconn (2317‑TW) and NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) have partnered to deploy NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD and DGX GB200 systems, accelerating the training of their in‑house large‑language model FoxBrain. The 120‑billion‑parameter model now trains 2.48 times faster than the previous H100‑based solution, processing 1 trillion tokens in 12 days and further strengthening AI model‑training capabilities for rollout across global manufacturing sites.

Using the NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD together with the Blackwell architecture and NVLink switches, multiple GPUs can be pooled to speed up large‑AI model training. Foxconn leverages this platform to train FoxBrain and, by integrating industrial data and multimodal reasoning, develop a visual‑language model that extends AI applications to manufacturing, electric vehicles and smart‑city domains.

In terms of training efficiency, Foxconn’s DGX SuperPOD runs the 120‑billion‑parameter model 2.48× faster than its earlier H100‑based setup; the system also processes 1 trillion tokens within 12 days, supporting continuous FoxBrain training and the development of multimodal capabilities.

Beyond faster model training, Foxconn is embedding AI into production management. An automated production scheduling (APS) system cuts factory scheduling labor by 25%, reducing the human burden of production planning. In injection‑molding processes, AI‑optimized settings halve the engineering effort required for process change, boosting overall workflow efficiency.

For line‑quality control, Foxconn uses AI to analyze SMT line issues, improving the root causes of more than 20 major defects with an abnormal‑improvement rate exceeding 90%. Real‑time AI model analysis and decision‑making extend AI use to the shop floor, helping identify line anomalies and accelerate problem‑resolution speed.

Foxconn also employs NVIDIA Mission Control to manage AI compute resources, supporting AI workload scheduling across more than 200 global sites. Combined with NVIDIA Run and NIM micro‑services, this enhances flexibility in AI model deployment. Additionally, NVIDIA RTX PRO servers enable digital‑twin simulations and AI‑agent workflows, while NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac simulate robots and production environments to validate and replicate lines, speeding AI adoption worldwide.

Foxconn will continue its collaboration with NVIDIA to advance AI in smart manufacturing, electric vehicles and smart cities. Through an AI token ecosystem and open‑agent framework, the company aims to help enterprises build customized AI agents, expanding AI technology’s reach across industries.

items.title: 主動式ETF規模逼近兆元！績效驗收差距拉開 00400A黑馬突圍
items.title_en: Active ETFs Near One Trillion! Performance Gap Widens, 00400A Dark Horse Breaks Through
paras: 主動式 ETF 熱潮持續延燒，截至 9 月底，全市場已有 40 檔，總規模達 9,886 億元、逼近兆元大關，受益人數突破 425 萬人，躍居 ETF 市場新寵。然而，隨著台股拉回與 AI 進入獲利驗證期，主動選股能力正面臨考驗，最新績效評比顯示市場明顯分化，近三個月報酬首尾差距逾 17 個百分點。在此波淘金熱中，主動國泰動能高息(00400A-TW)憑藉精準的進場時點與權重配置逆勢突圍，以 7.91% 報酬率躍居績效冠軍。
今年AI題材雖帶動台股攻高，但隨投資人開始檢視實質效益，投資邏輯已從題材追逐轉向獲利驗證，但即使同處AI供應鏈，企業在訂單品質與毛利率上的差異也讓股價走勢大不同，基金團隊的選股與調整功力更形重要。

根據投信投顧公會最新基金績效評比資料顯示，戰況已明顯分化，9月共有20檔台股主動式ETF列入績效評比；若從近三個月表現來看，僅9檔繳出正報酬，另有11檔落入負值，首尾差距達17.61個百分點，平均報酬率僅0.60%。在逾半數基金收黑之際，主動國泰動能高息(00400A-TW)則以7.91%的報酬率高居第一，不僅領先同類型基金平均7.31個百分點，更在盤勢起伏中逆勢突圍，成為這波績效競賽竄出的黑馬。
值得注意的是，檢視績效前段班主動式ETF的最新持股，部分熱門標的不乏重疊，為何最終繳出的成績仍有落差，也成為市場討論焦點。對此，券商表示，前十大持股只能呈現特定時間點的投資組合面貌，無法完整反映各基金的進場成本、持有期間、配置比重及調整過程，因此持股名單相似，不見得會帶來相同結果。
券商分析，真正拉開績效差距的關鍵，在於能否及早發掘成長企業、掌握進場時點及配置比重，並在股價明顯偏離企業價值時適度調整部位。即使是同一檔股票，早期布局後隨股價上漲而成為主要持股，與漲多後才提高配置，對基金績效的貢獻也可能截然不同。

00400A基金經理人梁恩溢表示，近期股市波動反映投資人重新評估企業前景，但AI需求並未消失，而是由題材驅動進入「獲利驗證」階段，選股除了看企業是否搭上AI列車，更要觀察技術門檻、競爭優勢與訂單品質是否順利轉化為實質營收。AI產業鏈橫跨半導體、伺服器、散熱及電力基礎建設等領域，各板塊受惠時程與成長速度不一，在類股快速輪動、個股表現分歧之際，投資組合必須隨產業脈動適時調整，並持續追蹤市場評價，聚焦獲利成長具有支撐且評價合理的優質企業。
展望後市，梁恩溢表示，企業財報、法說會及營運展望將持續牽動資金布局，大盤回檔不代表成長契機消失，反而可能進一步拉開企業間的表現差距。當資金重新回歸基本面，與其追逐短線熱門題材，更應聚焦具備獲利支撐、產業競爭力及合理評價的企業，透過主動布局掌握台股成長契機，同時兼顧風險控管。

paras_en: The active‑ETF boom continues to blaze. By the end of September, the market hosts 40 funds with a total net asset value of NT$9.886 billion, approaching the one‑trillion‑NT$ mark, and has attracted over 4.25 million investors, becoming the new darling of the ETF market. Yet, as the Taiwan stock index pulls back and AI moves into a profit‑validation phase, active stock‑picking skill is being tested. The latest performance rankings show a clear market split, with a more than 17‑percentage‑point gap in three‑month returns. In this gold‑rush, Cathay‑Active Momentum High‑Yield (00400A‑TW) leveraged precise entry timing and weight allocation to surge ahead, posting a 7.91% return to claim the performance crown.

This year AI themes have driven the Taiwan market higher, but as investors begin to scrutinise real benefits, investment logic has shifted from chasing themes to validating profits. Even within the AI supply chain, differences in order quality and margins cause stock price trajectories to diverge sharply, making the fund team’s stock‑selection and adjustment ability even more critical.

According to the latest fund performance data from the Investment Trust and Advisory Association, the battle lines are clearly drawn. In September, 20 Taiwan‑stock active ETFs were evaluated; over the past three months only nine delivered positive returns while eleven posted negatives, a spread of 17.61 percentage points and an average return of just 0.60%. While more than half of the funds turned red, Cathay‑Active Momentum High‑Yield (00400A‑TW) topped the list with a 7.91% return, out‑performing its peers by 7.31 percentage points and breaking out against market volatility as the dark horse of this performance contest.

It is noteworthy that a look at the latest holdings of the top‑performing active ETFs shows considerable overlap among popular stocks. Why the final results still differ has become a market talking point. Brokers explain that the top‑ten holdings only reflect a snapshot of the portfolio at a specific time and cannot fully capture each fund’s entry cost, holding period, allocation weight and adjustment process; thus similar holdings do not necessarily yield identical outcomes.

Broker analysis points to the real driver of performance gaps: the ability to spot growth companies early, time entries correctly, and size allocations appropriately, then adjust positions when prices stray far from intrinsic value. Even with the same stock, early positioning that rides a price rise can become a core holding, whereas increasing weight only after a big jump contributes very differently to fund performance.

Fund manager Liang En‑yi of the 00400A fund said recent market swings reflect investors re‑evaluating corporate outlooks, but AI demand has not vanished—it has moved from a theme‑driven surge to a “profit‑validation” stage. Stock selection now looks beyond whether a company is on the AI train to assess technical barriers, competitive advantages and whether order quality translates into real revenue. The AI value chain spans semiconductors, servers, cooling and power infrastructure, with each segment benefitting at different times and speeds. Amid rapid sector rotation and divergent stock performance, portfolios must adjust with industry rhythms, continuously track market valuations and focus on high‑quality firms with profit growth, solid fundamentals and reasonable pricing.

Looking ahead, Liang En‑yi said corporate earnings reports, briefings and outlooks will keep steering capital allocation. A market pull‑back does not mean growth opportunities disappear; it may even widen performance gaps between companies. When capital returns to fundamentals, investors should focus less on short‑term hot themes and more on firms with profit support, competitive industry positions and fair valuations, using active positioning to capture Taiwan‑stock growth opportunities while managing risk.
