items.title: iPhone Duo剛開賣就出問題！螢幕爆裂痕、軟體相容挨批、價格跌破原價
items.title_en: iPhone Duo Hits Trouble Right After Launch: Screen Cracks, Software Compatibility Criticized, Prices Slip Below List Price
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 首款摺疊手機 iPhone Duo 於 10 月 23 日正式開賣，但上市才短短數日，就有首批用戶回報內螢幕沿摺疊處開裂、出現亮線等問題。與此同時，第三方通路已出現低於官方定價的報價，軟體相容也未盡理想，讓這款備受期待的新機面臨硬體可靠性、價格與使用體驗等多重考驗。
據多家外媒報導，部分 iPhone Duo 用戶表示，手機在正常開合過程中就發生螢幕故障。一名澳洲用戶指出，手機到手約 6 小時、開合不到 20 次，內螢幕便沿著摺疊位置裂開。
該用戶表示，當時正準備向朋友展示手機的摺疊功能，展開過程中先感覺鉸鏈內部出現異常，隨後聽到明顯的碎裂聲，螢幕也隨即受損。他強調，手機此前沒有遭受撞擊或擠壓，螢幕表面與外部鉸鏈也未見明顯損傷。事後前往 Apple Store 反映，蘋果直接為他更換新機。
類似情況也有其他用戶回報。有中國用戶表示，正常展開手機時，螢幕摺疊處突然出現約 3 公分長的黑色裂紋，並伴隨橫向亮線。目前曝光的案例中，故障位置多集中在內螢幕中央、靠近鉸鏈的區域，部分裝置還出現橫向亮線。
知名維修機構 iFixit 近期拆解 iPhone Duo 後發現，機身內部採用複雜的齒輪、彈簧及金屬連接結構，透過特殊設計控制柔性螢幕在開合時承受的力量。
拆解分析也提出一種可能性：若鉸鏈內部的中央支撐結構未能正常回縮，或活動零件發生位置偏移，就可能對螢幕施加額外壓力，進而造成顯示面板損壞。
不過，這目前仍只是根據拆解結果提出的技術推測，尚無法確認螢幕故障究竟源自個別零件缺陷、組裝問題，還是整體結構設計。

第三方通路價格跌破官方定價　黃牛轉售空間受壓

除了硬體問題，iPhone Duo 的市場價格也開始鬆動。
此前，蘋果官網一度顯示交貨時間延長至 2027 年 1 月，部分消費者與黃牛原本期待藉由首批貨源短缺賺取轉售價差。不過，隨著第三方通路陸續供貨，部分中國電商平台已出現優惠後人民幣 15,099 元的報價，較官方 15,999 人民幣起售價低 900 人民幣。
但這類優惠通常需要搶購限量優惠券，並非所有消費者都能以該價格購買。部分商家還要求買家當面簽收並完成開機啟用，啟用後不接受七天無理由退貨。
另一方面，抖音電商平台上的蘋果授權專營店也已開放下單。其中，256GB 版本售價為人民幣 15,999 元，與蘋果官方定價相同，商品頁面並標示付款後隔日出貨。
第三方通路開始提供正常購買管道，意味著消費者不必完全仰賴首批稀缺貨源，也讓原本期待加價轉售的黃牛面臨更大壓力。

軟體相容不如預期　蘋果自家 App 也未充分利用大螢幕

硬體故障與價格變化之外，iPhone Duo 的軟體相容同樣引發討論。部分應用程式即使在手機展開後，仍維持傳統 iPhone 的介面比例，未能充分利用更大的顯示空間。
蘋果自家的 Apple Store 購物 App 就出現這類問題。手機展開後，應用程式仍以傳統手機的直向比例顯示，周圍留下大片黑色區域；即使手動調整視窗大小，內容也沒有重新配置版面。
相較之下，特斯拉(TSLA-US) App 在 iPhone Duo 開賣前便推出更新，針對 iPad 與摺疊手機等大螢幕裝置調整介面。手機展開並橫向使用時，畫面可採類似平板的寬螢幕布局，左側呈現車輛資訊、充電、升級及服務等功能，右側則顯示較大幅度的車輛 3D 模型。
不過，特斯拉 App 也並非所有頁面都已完善，首批測試中，車輛 3D 展示頁面出現無法拖動的問題，個人頁面的相容表現也仍有改善空間。
在中國市場，微信的相容更是用戶關注的焦點。iPhone Duo 剛上市時，微信聊天畫面仍以傳統手機比例置中顯示，兩側留下大片黑邊。
之後微信推出 8.0.80 版本，開始支援展開後的左右分欄布局，左側顯示聊天列表，右側呈現對話內容，但整體設計仍被認為較為生硬，部分黑邊、手勢操作及工具列位置也有待調整。
微信朋友圈則仍維持單欄資訊流，沒有針對摺疊大螢幕重新設計。至於公眾號文章頁面，原有的帳號資訊及按讚、轉發、收藏、評論等操作，也還有重新配置的空間。
此外，微信於 10 月 24 日進一步開放與其他手機同時登入的功能，部分 iPhone Duo 用戶已能選擇讓摺疊手機與另一台手機共用同一個微信帳號。不過，該功能目前仍採灰度開放，並非所有用戶都能使用。
其他熱門 App 的表現也不一致。抖音展開後仍維持傳統手機的直向畫面，周圍留下大片黑邊，雖然影片能正常播放，但未充分利用大螢幕。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) launched its first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, on October 23. Within just a few days of release, early users reported internal screen cracks and bright lines along the fold. At the same time, third‑party channels began offering prices below Apple’s official list, and software compatibility fell short, putting the highly anticipated device under pressure for hardware reliability, pricing and user experience.

According to multiple foreign media outlets, some iPhone Duo owners said the screen failed during normal opening and closing. An Australian user noted that after about six hours of use and fewer than 20 folds, the internal screen cracked along the folding line.

The user said he was about to demonstrate the folding feature to a friend when he felt an abnormality inside the hinge, heard a distinct shattering sound, and saw the screen damage immediately. He emphasized that the phone had not been dropped or squeezed, and the screen surface and outer hinge showed no obvious damage. He later visited an Apple Store, where Apple replaced the device with a new one.

Similar reports came from other users. A Chinese user said that while opening the phone normally, a roughly 3‑centimeter black crack appeared at the fold, accompanied by a horizontal bright line. In the cases disclosed so far, failures tend to cluster in the center of the internal screen near the hinge, with some devices also showing horizontal bright lines.

Well‑known repair firm iFixit recently disassembled the iPhone Duo and found a complex internal structure of gears, springs and metal connections designed to control the forces on the flexible display during opening and closing.

The teardown analysis suggested a possible cause: if the central support inside the hinge fails to retract properly or moving parts shift out of position, extra pressure could be applied to the screen, leading to panel damage.

However, this remains a technical hypothesis based on the teardown; it has not been confirmed whether the screen failures stem from a specific component defect, an assembly issue, or the overall structural design.
Third‑party channel prices have fallen below Apple’s list price, squeezing scalpers’ resale margins.

Earlier, Apple’s website showed delivery dates pushed back to January 2027, and some consumers and scalpers hoped to profit from the shortage of the first batch. As third‑party channels gradually stocked the phone, some Chinese e‑commerce platforms listed the device for 15,099 CNY after discounts, about 900 CNY lower than Apple’s starting price of 15,999 CNY.

These discounted offers usually require snapping up limited‑quantity coupons, so not every consumer can buy at that price. Some sellers also require in‑person receipt and device activation, and they do not accept seven‑day no‑reason returns after activation.

Meanwhile, Apple‑authorized stores on the Douyin e‑commerce platform have opened for orders. The 256 GB model is priced at 15,999 CNY, matching Apple’s official price, and the product page states that it ships the next day after payment.

The emergence of normal purchase channels through third‑party sellers means consumers no longer have to rely solely on the scarce first‑batch stock, putting additional pressure on scalpers who hoped to flip the device at a premium.
Software compatibility has also drawn criticism. Some apps still use the traditional iPhone aspect ratio even after the phone is unfolded, failing to take full advantage of the larger display.

Apple’s own Apple Store shopping app exhibits this issue. After unfolding, the app still displays in the portrait ratio of a regular phone, leaving large black bars on the sides; even manually resizing the window does not re‑layout the content.

In contrast, Tesla’s (TSLA-US) app released an update before the iPhone Duo launch that adapts its interface for large‑screen devices such as iPads and foldables. When the phone is unfolded and used in landscape, the app adopts a tablet‑like wide layout, with vehicle info, charging, upgrades and services on the left and a larger 3‑D vehicle model on the right.
However, the Tesla app is not perfect; during early testing, the 3‑D vehicle display page could not be dragged, and the personal‑page compatibility still has room for improvement.

In China, WeChat’s compatibility is a particular focus for users. When the iPhone Duo first launched, WeChat’s chat screen remained centered in the traditional phone aspect ratio, leaving large black borders on both sides.

WeChat later released version 8.0.80, adding support for a split‑screen layout after unfolding: the chat list appears on the left and the conversation on the right. The overall design is still considered somewhat clunky, with remaining black borders, gesture handling and toolbar placement needing tweaks.

WeChat Moments still uses a single‑column feed and has not been redesigned for the foldable’s larger screen. Public‑account article pages also retain the original account info and like, share, bookmark and comment controls, leaving space for re‑layout.

On October 24, WeChat further opened a feature allowing simultaneous login on another phone, enabling some iPhone Duo users to share a WeChat account with a second device. The feature is currently in a gray‑scale rollout and not available to all users.

Performance of other popular apps is also inconsistent. Douyin, when unfolded, still shows a traditional portrait view with large black borders; videos play normally but the large screen is not fully utilized.

items.title: AI資料中心成美國大選最新政治炸彈！川普力挺建設、州級暫停令機率升至27%
items.title_en: AI Data Centers Become the Latest Political Bomb in the U.S. Election! Trump Backs Construction, Statewide Pause Probability Rises to 27%
paras: 儘管美國資料中心建設面臨日益升高的地方反對聲浪，美國總統川普仍持續為相關基礎設施發聲，並提出由業者與社區分享經濟利益、要求大型新建資料中心自行發電等構想，希望降低居民疑慮。然而，民意反彈、地方停工措施與政治壓力仍持續發酵，資料中心擴建也逐漸成為美國政治議題。
預測市場平台 Polymarket 發文指出，川普敦促美國各地社區冷靜看待資料中心建設。該平台當時顯示，今年底前至少有一個州通過全州適用的資料中心暫停立法，機率約為27%。
根據合約規則，只要有任何一州在12月31日前通過相關立法，該合約便以「是」結算；10月24日市場報價約為28%。

川普提議分享收益　資料中心建設仍遭地方反對

川普一直支持擴建資料中心。8月底，他曾在社群平台表示，社區反對資料中心的原因，是不願進步、希望維持貧窮，並稱中國樂見美國反資料中心運動持續發展。
到了10月21日，川普轉而提出利益分享方案，建議資料中心業者向所在地社區或居民支付分紅。他也要求新建大型資料中心自行供電，並將多餘電力回售給社區，認為此舉不僅能避免電價上漲，甚至可能大幅降低電費。
白宮7月底宣布，已有超過200家電力公司、州政府與開發商加入川普提出的電費保護承諾，涵蓋全美約八成居民用電。
不過，民意調查顯示，資料中心選址仍面臨顯著阻力。《ABC》、《華盛頓郵報》與Ipsos聯合民調指出，72%的美國受訪者反對在自家附近興建資料中心，農村地區的反對比例更達78%。
資料中心議題也逐漸進入選舉攻防。部分民主黨人將地方反對聲浪視為競選議題，共和黨內也有候選人與川普的立場拉開距離。密西根州參議員候選人羅傑斯（Mike Rogers）便公開支持暫停建設。
紐約州州長霍楚（Kathy Hochul）已發布全州首個資料中心開發暫停令。研究機構22V Research則預測，支持資料中心建設的州可能從27個減少至約15個。

業者祭出現金回饋　仍難平息居民疑慮

面對地方阻力，川普主張讓社區直接分享資料中心帶來的經濟利益。他表示，部分原本不受歡迎的資料中心計畫，在業者與地方達成財務協議後，便獲得更多支持。
部分開發商已採取類似做法。密蘇里州開發商NorthPoint曾承諾，若資料中心建成投用，將向賓州Hazle鎮每戶家庭支付1萬美元。
但金錢補償並未消除所有反對意見。Hazle鎮居民最終取得法院停工令；馬里蘭州弗雷德里克縣一項價值1.1億美元的社區回饋方案，也遭縣長否決，當地暫停令的期限反而延長至2027年7月。
部分居民更質疑，以現金換取地方支持並非解決問題的適當方式。一名退休居民接受法新社訪問時，便將這類安排形容為賄賂。
資料中心建設的爭議，因而不只涉及開發商願意提供多少補償，也包括地方居民是否接受相關建設，以及電力供應與社區利益能否獲得保障。
美國期中選舉將於11月3日舉行，資料中心建設已成為選舉期間受到關注的議題。隨著地方反對聲浪、州級暫停措施與業者補償方案持續交錯，後續政策走向仍將影響美國資料中心的擴建進程。
paras_en: Despite growing local opposition to data‑center construction in the United States, President Trump continues to champion the related infrastructure, proposing ideas such as sharing economic benefits with operators and communities and requiring large new data centers to generate their own power, in hopes of easing residents' concerns. Nevertheless, public backlash, local shutdown measures and political pressure keep mounting, and data‑center expansion is gradually turning into a political issue in the U.S.

The prediction market platform Polymarket posted that Trump is urging communities across the country to view data‑center construction calmly. The platform at the time indicated that there is about a 27% chance that at least one state will pass statewide legislation to pause data‑center projects before the end of the year.
According to the contract rules, if any state passes the relevant legislation by December 31, the contract settles as "yes"; on October 24 the market price was roughly 28%.

Trump proposes profit‑sharing; data‑center construction still faces local opposition. Trump has long supported expanding data centers. At the end of August he said on social media that communities oppose data centers because they are unwilling to progress and want to stay poor, adding that China welcomes the continued development of the anti‑data‑center movement in the United States.

By October 21, Trump shifted to a profit‑sharing proposal, suggesting that data‑center operators pay dividends to the host community or residents. He also demanded that new large data centers generate their own electricity and sell any surplus back to the community, arguing that this would not only prevent electricity price hikes but could dramatically lower power bills.

The White House announced in late July that more than 200 power companies, state governments and developers have joined Trump's electricity‑protection pledge, covering roughly 80% of U.S. residential electricity consumption.

However, polls show that locating data centers still faces significant resistance. A joint poll by ABC, The Washington Post and Ipsos found that 72% of American respondents oppose building a data center near their homes, with opposition in rural areas climbing to 78%.

The data‑center issue is also creeping into election battles. Some Democrats are treating local opposition as a campaign theme, while within the Republican Party some candidates are distancing themselves from Trump’s stance. Michigan Senate candidate Mike Rogers publicly supported pausing construction.

New York Governor Kathy Hochul has issued the state's first data‑center development moratorium. Research firm 22V Research predicts that the number of states supporting data‑center construction could drop from 27 to about 15.

Operators offer cash rebates but still struggle to calm resident concerns. Facing local resistance, Trump argues that communities should directly share the economic benefits of data centers. He says that some previously unpopular data‑center projects gained more support after operators reached financial agreements with localities.
Some developers have already adopted similar tactics. Missouri developer NorthPoint pledged to pay $10,000 per household in Hazle, Pennsylvania, if the data center is built and put into operation.

But monetary compensation has not eliminated all opposition. Hazle residents ultimately secured a court‑ordered shutdown; a $110 million community‑benefit plan in Frederick County, Maryland, was vetoed by the county executive, and the local moratorium was extended instead, now running until July 2027.
Some residents further question whether paying cash for local support is an appropriate solution. A retired resident interviewed by AFP described such arrangements as bribery.

The controversy over data‑center construction therefore involves not only how much compensation developers are willing to provide, but also whether local residents accept the projects and whether power supply and community benefits can be guaranteed.

The U.S. midterm elections will be held on November 3, and data‑center construction has become a topic of attention during the campaign. As local opposition, state‑level moratoria and developer compensation schemes continue to intersect, the policy direction that follows will still shape the pace of data‑center expansion in the United States.

items.title: LS Eco Energy投入650億韓元擴產超級電容，越南基地2027年4月供貨
items.title_en: LS Eco Energy Invests 65 Billion Won to Expand Supercapacitor Production, Vietnam Plant to Supply by April 2027
paras: 2026年10月26日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 南韓LS Eco Energy於10月26日宣布，旗下越南子公司LSCV將投資約650億韓元（約新台幣16億元），增設AI資料中心用超級電容產線，預計2027年4月量產供貨。新產線將採用關係企業LS Materials的技術，由LSCV負責代工，讓公司從既有電線業務跨入資料中心電力零組件市場。
這項投資主要為了承接LS Materials新增的訂單。LS Materials已於10月13日與一家美國氫燃料電池業者簽訂約5,150萬美元（約新台幣16.8億元）供貨合約，目前也在洽談年內追加訂單。越南產線投產後，LS Materials將增加韓國以外的供貨來源。LSCV目標是2030年這項業務年營收達到約1,500億韓元（約新台幣36.9億元），後續是否繼續擴產，將視接單情況決定。
超級電容能快速充放電，在氫燃料電池發電系統中，可用來補足瞬間增加的用電需求。公司看好AI資料中心用電持續增加，帶動燃料電池發電設備投資，超級電容的需求也將隨之成長。
新產線將設在LSCV既有廠區的閒置土地。LS Eco Energy表示，越南的人力與水電等成本較低，有助降低生產成本。公司也預期，超級電容的獲利能力高於一般電線，隨著新業務開始貢獻營收，可望提高整體利潤率。
超級電容的應用已涵蓋交通運輸、能源與工業設備。在汽車與軌道交通領域，可用於引擎啟動、煞車能量回收及瞬間動力輔助；在風力發電領域，則可作為葉片角度控制系統的備援電源。此外，工廠自動搬運車（AGV）、不斷電系統（UPS）與電網電力品質管理，也都是既有應用。這些場景的共同需求，是短時間內快速充放電，並承受頻繁、反覆的使用。
AI資料中心則帶來新的需求。GPU運算負載快速變化，會讓用電功率在短時間內大幅升降，增加供電設備的負擔。超級電容可依系統設計配置在伺服器機櫃、配電設備或發電系統端，在用電突然增加時快速供電，負載下降後再充電，降低功率波動對上游電力系統的影響。
超級電容與電池在這類系統中各有分工：超級電容擅長處理短時間、反覆出現的高功率需求，電池則適合儲存較多電量，支援較長時間的備援供電。因此，AI資料中心擴建帶來的機會，除了增加備用電力，也包括處理運算過程中更頻繁的用電波動，讓超級電容有更多搭配電池與發電設備使用的空間。
LS Materials本次取得的訂單，就是用於協助氫燃料電池系統因應資料中心負載變化，讓公司既有的風電、AGV與UPS業務，進一步拓展至AI電力基礎設施。

paras_en: On October 26, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – South Korea’s LS Eco Energy announced that its Vietnam subsidiary LSCV will invest about 650 billion won (approximately NT$1.6 billion) to add a super‑capacitor production line for AI data‑center applications, with mass production slated for April 2027. The new line will use technology from affiliated LS Materials and be manufactured by LSCV, allowing the company to move from its existing wire business into the data‑center power‑component market.

The investment is mainly to fulfill new orders from LS Materials. LS Materials signed a roughly $51.5 million (about NT$1.68 billion) supply contract on October 13 with a U.S. hydrogen fuel‑cell company and is currently negotiating additional orders within the year. Once the Vietnam line is operational, LS Materials will add a supply source outside Korea. LSCV aims for the business to generate about 150 billion won (around NT$3.69 billion) in annual revenue by 2030, with any further expansion dependent on order volume.

Supercapacitors can charge and discharge rapidly and are used in hydrogen fuel‑cell power systems to meet sudden spikes in electricity demand. The company expects AI data‑center electricity consumption to keep rising, driving investment in fuel‑cell generators and, consequently, growing demand for supercapacitors.

The new line will be built on idle land within LSCV’s existing plant. LS Eco Energy said lower labor, water and electricity costs in Vietnam will help reduce production expenses. The firm also expects supercapacitors to be more profitable than ordinary wires, and as the new business begins to contribute revenue, overall profit margins should improve.

Supercapacitor applications already span transportation, energy and industrial equipment. In automotive and rail sectors they are used for engine start‑up, brake‑energy recovery and instant power assist; in wind‑power plants they serve as backup power for blade‑pitch control systems. They are also employed in factory automated guided vehicles (AGVs), uninterruptible power supplies (UPS) and power‑quality management for grids. All these use cases share a need for fast, short‑duration charge‑discharge cycles and frequent, repeated use.

AI data centers create new demand. Rapidly changing GPU workloads cause power draw to surge or drop sharply in short periods, stressing power‑supply equipment. Supercapacitors can be placed in server racks, distribution gear or generator systems to deliver quick power when demand spikes and recharge when load falls, mitigating power fluctuations that affect upstream grids.

In such systems supercapacitors and batteries have complementary roles: supercapacitors handle short‑term, repeated high‑power bursts, while batteries store larger amounts of energy for longer‑duration backup. Thus, AI data‑center expansion not only adds backup power but also increases the frequency of power‑fluctuation events, giving supercapacitors more opportunities to work alongside batteries and generators.

The order LS Materials secured this time is intended to help hydrogen fuel‑cell systems cope with data‑center load variations, allowing the company’s existing wind‑power, AGV and UPS businesses to further expand into AI power‑infrastructure.

paras: 2026年10月26日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 亞洲股市周一走勢保守，市場等待本週密集公布的央行利率決策與科技大廠財報。布蘭特原油自六個月高點回落，但能源價格帶來的通膨壓力仍受關注；微軟、亞馬遜與Alphabet的業績，也將考驗投資人對AI熱潮的信心。
亞洲盤中，日經225指數下跌0.2%，上週已下跌4%；南韓綜合指數下跌0.5%，本月累計跌幅接近20%。MSCI亞太不含日本指數大致持平，滬深300指數下跌0.5%。中國股市此前已連跌11週，出口雖維持強勁，市場仍擔心內需表現。
油價方面，消息指出，卡達斡旋代表週日抵達德黑蘭，與美方協調推動區域局勢降溫。布蘭特原油期貨下跌1.9%，每桶報114.48美元；美國原油期貨下跌2.2%，報101.01美元。布蘭特原油上週大漲6.2%，週線收盤價創2022年中以來最高，主要受到胡塞武裝攻擊沙烏地阿拉伯、引發能源供應疑慮影響。
葉門胡塞武裝周一再宣稱，已攻擊沙烏地東西向輸油管線的泵站及利雅德機場，但沙烏地方面尚未立即證實。高盛指出，油價高於原先預估，主要來自市場擔心與伊朗的衝突進一步擴大；能源價格衝擊愈大、持續時間愈長，聯準會官員就愈可能擔心通膨壓力向其他項目擴散。
本週利率決策方面，市場預期聯準會、日本銀行與歐洲央行將維持利率不變，加拿大及紐西蘭央行則可能升息。目前市場反映聯準會12月升息機率約八成，日本銀行與歐洲央行的定價也相近。摩根大通全球經濟研究主管Bruce Kasman認為，全球已進入幅度相對有限的升息循環，英國與瑞典可能於下月首次升息。
美國核心通膨數據預估顯示，9月年增率仍維持3.1%；經濟成長率按季換算年率則預估達3.2%，部分受到資料中心支出快速增加支持。美國10年期公債殖利率目前約4.97%，低於本月稍早的5.36%高點，但殖利率上升仍對股票估值形成壓力。

企業財報方面，本週約有三分之一的標普500成分股公布業績。市場預估，微軟Microsoft(MSFT-US)營收為906億美元，調整後每股盈餘4.73美元；亞馬遜Amazon(AMZN-US)營收為2,020億美元，每股盈餘約1.97美元；Alphabet(GOOGL-US)營收為1,280億美元，每股盈餘3美元。英特爾Intel(INTC-US)與Sandisk(SNDK-US)財報，也可能牽動AI相關股票走勢。
亞洲則聚焦SK海力士SK Hynix(000660-KR)與三星電子Samsung Electronics(005930-KR)，兩家公司均將於本週公布財報。針對媒體報導考慮發放約16兆韓元、折合120億美元的特別股利，SK海力士表示，將於週三公布股東回饋措施。
美歐股指期貨小幅走高，標普500與那斯達克期貨分別上漲0.2%、0.1%；歐洲Stoxx 50及德國DAX期貨均上漲0.3%，英國富時期貨上漲0.4%。日圓報156.90日圓兌1美元，上週升值約0.8%；歐元上漲0.1%，報1.1220美元，法國上週未遭調降信評。黃金現貨上漲0.4%，每盎司報4,012美元，上週則下跌超過4%。
巴西方面，依選舉法院公布結果，總統魯拉週日贏得第四個任期，但參議員Flavio Bolsonaro拒絕承認敗選，並表示將尋求撤銷決選結果。在東京掛牌的巴西股票ETF下跌15%，回吐先前因Bolsonaro首輪投票領先帶來的漲幅。

paras_en: On Monday, Asian stock markets moved cautiously as investors awaited a packed week of central‑bank rate decisions and earnings from major tech firms. Brent crude fell from a six‑month high, but inflation pressure from energy prices remains a concern; the results of Microsoft, Amazon and Alphabet will also test investors' confidence in the AI boom.

During Asian trading, the Nikkei 225 slipped 0.2% after a 4% drop last week, while South Korea's KOSPI fell 0.5%, bringing its monthly decline close to 20%. The MSCI Asia‑Pacific ex‑Japan index was roughly flat and China's CSI 300 slipped 0.5%. Chinese markets have now logged 11 consecutive weeks of losses; despite strong export figures, worries about domestic demand persist.

On the oil front, reports said a Qatari‑mediated delegation arrived in Tehran on Sunday to coordinate with the United States on de‑escalating regional tensions. Brent crude futures fell 1.9% to $114.48 a barrel, while U.S. crude dropped 2.2% to $101.01. Brent had surged 6.2% the previous week, closing at its highest level since mid‑2022, driven mainly by Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia that raised supply‑security concerns.

The Yemeni Houthi group claimed on Monday it had struck a Saudi east‑west pipeline pump station and Riyadh airport, though Saudi authorities have not immediately confirmed the attacks. Goldman Sachs noted that oil prices are higher than originally forecast, mainly because markets fear the conflict with Iran could widen; the larger and longer‑lasting the energy‑price shock, the more likely Fed officials will worry about inflation spilling into other sectors.

Regarding this week’s rate decisions, markets expect the Federal Reserve, the Bank of Japan and the European Central Bank to hold rates steady, while the Bank of Canada and the Reserve Bank of New Zealand may raise rates. The market currently assigns roughly an 80% probability to a Fed hike in December, with similar pricing for the BOJ and ECB. JPMorgan Global Economics head Bruce Kasman says the world has entered a relatively limited tightening cycle, with the UK and Sweden possibly delivering their first hikes next month.

U.S. core‑inflation data are projected to show a 3.1% year‑over‑year increase for September, while quarterly‑annualised GDP growth is expected at 3.2%, partly supported by a rapid rise in data‑center spending. The 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield sits around 4.97%, below the early‑month peak of 5.36%, but the upward trend still pressures equity valuations.

On the earnings side, about one‑third of S&P 500 constituents are slated to report this week. Analysts expect Microsoft (MSFT‑US) to post revenue of $90.6 billion with adjusted EPS of $4.73; Amazon (AMZN‑US) to report $202 billion in revenue and about $1.97 EPS; and Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) to generate $128 billion in revenue with $3 EPS. Intel (INTC‑US) and SanDisk (SNDK‑US) results could also move AI‑related stocks.

In Asia, focus turns to SK Hynix (000660‑KR) and Samsung Electronics (005930‑KR), both due to release earnings this week. SK Hynix, which is considering a special dividend of roughly 16 trillion won (about $12 billion), said it will announce shareholder‑return measures on Wednesday.

U.S. and European stock‑index futures edged higher, with S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures up 0.2% and 0.1% respectively; Europe’s Stoxx 50 and German DAX futures each rose 0.3%, while the UK FTSE futures gained 0.4%. The yen traded at 156.90 per dollar, about 0.8% stronger on the week; the euro rose 0.1% to $1.1220 as France avoided a rating downgrade last week. Spot gold climbed 0.4% to $4,012 an ounce after falling more than 4% the previous week.

In Brazil, following the electoral court’s announcement, President Lula secured a fourth term on Sunday, but Senator Flavio Bolsonaro refused to acknowledge his defeat and said he would seek to overturn the result. A Brazil‑focused stock ETF listed in Tokyo fell 15%, erasing gains that had earlier been driven by Bolsonaro’s initial lead in the vote.

items.title: 塞爾維亞議會選舉變天？武契奇坦言恐落敗、學生陣營宣布勝選
items.title_en: Serbian Parliamentary Election Upset? Vučić Admits Fear of Defeat, Student Bloc Claims Victory
paras: 塞爾維亞前總統武契奇（Aleksandar Vučić）週日（25日）晚間表示，根據分層抽樣統計結果，由他領銜的「亞歷山大·武契奇－團結的塞爾維亞」參選名單，可能在當天舉行的提前議會選舉中落敗。他預測，由學生組成的「學生名單－學生獲勝」有望取得國民議會過半席次。
武契奇當晚在塞爾維亞前進黨競選總部發表談話指出，儘管官方尚未公布最終選舉結果，但現有統計已顯示，他所領導的參選名單未能勝出。與此同時，「學生名單-學生獲勝」25日亦宣布，在當天舉行的議會選舉中獲勝。
他預估，「學生名單－學生獲勝」將取得國民議會250個席次中的135至140席，而他領銜的參選名單則可能獲得約105席。
不過，塞爾維亞共和國選舉委員會稍早公布的首批初步計票數據，與武契奇的預測有所不同。
根據已完成統計的203個投票站數據，「亞歷山大·武契奇－團結的塞爾維亞」參選名單得票率為54.69%，「學生名單－學生獲勝」則為36.04%。
然而，由於當時納入統計的投票站數量有限，這批數據尚不足以反映全國整體選情。
此次塞爾維亞提前議會選舉於當地時間25日上午7時開始投票，晚間8時結束。全國登記選民超過645萬人，共有18份參選名單、2,418名候選人角逐國民議會250個席次。
目前選舉結果仍未定案，最終席次分配有待塞爾維亞共和國選舉委員會正式公布。
武契奇此前獲塞爾維亞前進黨推舉，擔任該黨國會選舉名單領銜人及總理候選人。他於9月9日簽署解散國會的總統令，宣布提前於10月25日舉行議會選舉，並於9月27日卸下總統職務。
武契奇於2017年4月當選總統，並在2022年5月成功連任。根據塞爾維亞憲法，總統任期為5年，最多只能連任一次。在出任總統之前，他曾於2012年擔任第一副總理，並於2014年出任總理。
塞爾維亞官方數據顯示，該國失業率已從2012年的約24%降至2025年的約9%，以歐元計算的名目國內生產毛額（GDP）也增至2012年的兩倍以上。2024年，塞爾維亞吸引外國直接投資約52億歐元，創下歷史新高。
與傳統政黨組成的選舉名單相比，「學生名單－學生獲勝」的成員背景更加多元，涵蓋醫師、大學教授、演員、運動員及金融業從業人員等不同領域。
波蘭東方研究中心研究員諾維諾夫斯基指出，學生團體提出的反貪腐等主張具有廣泛的社會動員力，但其整體施政方向仍不夠明確，尚缺乏完整的改革方案、具體執行路徑及推動時程規劃。
本次選舉共有18份選舉名單、2,418名候選人參與角逐，當選者將組成新一屆國民議會。參選陣營包括由塞爾維亞前進黨主導的「亞歷山大·武契奇－團結的塞爾維亞」、學生團體推動的「學生名單－學生獲勝」，以及由塞爾維亞社會黨等政黨組成的「伊維察·達契奇－穩定的力量！」等。
塞爾維亞議會選舉採比例代表制，選民投票支持政黨或政黨聯盟提出的名單，國民議會再依各名單的得票比例分配250個席次。除少數族裔選舉名單外，一般名單須取得至少3%的總票數，才能參與議席分配。
paras_en: Former Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić said on Sunday evening (the 25th) that, based on stratified sampling statistics, the list he leads, "Aleksandar Vučić – United Serbia," could lose in the early parliamentary election scheduled for that day. He predicted that the student‑led "Student List – Students Win" is likely to secure a majority of seats in the National Assembly.

Vučić spoke at the Serbian Progressive Party campaign headquarters that night, noting that although the official final results have not yet been released, the existing statistics already show his list failed to win. At the same time, the "Student List – Students Win" announced on the 25th that it had won the parliamentary election that day.
He estimated the "Student List – Students Win" would obtain 135 to 140 of the 250 seats in the National Assembly, while his own list might receive about 105 seats.
However, the first batch of preliminary vote counts released earlier by the Republic Election Commission differed from Vučić’s forecast.
Based on data from 203 polling stations that have been processed, the "Aleksandar Vučić – United Serbia" list recorded a vote share of 54.69%, while the "Student List – Students Win" earned 36.04%.
Because the number of polling stations included in the count was limited at the time, these figures are not sufficient to reflect the nationwide voting trend.

The early parliamentary election in Serbia began at 7 a.m. local time on the 25th and ended at 8 p.m. that evening. More than 6.45 million voters were registered nationwide, with 18 electoral lists and 2,418 candidates contesting the 250 seats in the National Assembly.
The election outcome remains undecided, and the final seat allocation will await formal publication by the Republic Election Commission.

Vučić was previously nominated by the Serbian Progressive Party as the lead candidate on its parliamentary list and as the prime‑ministerial candidate. He signed a presidential decree on September 9 dissolving parliament and calling an early election for October 25, and he stepped down from the presidency on September 27.

Vučić was first elected president in April 2017 and was re‑elected in May 2022. Under the Serbian constitution, the presidential term is five years and may be renewed only once. Before becoming president, he served as first deputy prime minister in 2012 and became prime minister in 2014.

Official Serbian data show that the unemployment rate has fallen from about 24 % in 2012 to roughly 9 % in 2025, and nominal GDP measured in euros has more than doubled since 2012. In 2024, Serbia attracted about €5.2 billion in foreign direct investment, a historic high.
Compared with traditional party‑based lists, the "Student List – Students Win" features a more diverse roster, including doctors, university professors, actors, athletes and finance professionals.

Researcher Novinowski of the Polish Centre for Eastern Studies noted that the student group’s anti‑corruption platform has broad mobilising power, but its overall policy direction remains vague, lacking a complete reform programme, concrete implementation pathways and a timeline for action.

A total of 18 electoral lists and 2,418 candidates took part in the election, with the winners forming the new National Assembly. The competing camps include the Serbian Progressive Party‑led "Aleksandar Vučić – United Serbia," the student‑driven "Student List – Students Win," and coalitions such as "Ivica Dačić – Stable Force!" formed by the Serbian Social Party and others.

Serbian parliamentary elections use a proportional‑representation system: voters cast ballots for parties or party alliances, and seats in the 250‑member National Assembly are allocated according to each list’s share of the vote. Except for minority lists, a general list must obtain at least 3 % of the total vote to qualify for seat distribution.

items.title: 十月累漲4.6%！瑞士股市成為市場AI恐慌下的避風港
items.title_en: October Up 4.6%: Swiss Market Becomes a Safe Haven Amid AI Panic
paras: 瑞士股指本月迄今累計上漲4.6%，而歐元區大盤指數歐洲Stoxx 50同期跌幅則達3.2%，兩者近8個百分點的超額收益創2020年3月以來最高。這一反差背後是歐洲投資人在融資成本走高、AI交易遇冷及法西政局動盪之際，主動降低風險敞口，轉向防禦資產。
上漲幾乎全由三大權重股拉動：羅氏漲12%、諾華漲6.7%、雀巢漲10%，這三檔老牌防禦龍頭貢獻指數全部漲幅，合計佔指數近半權重。
EFG資產管理指出，資金正從擁擠的AI交易撤出，回流獲利紮實、對利率敏感度低的醫藥與食品部門。美銀調查也顯示，淨16%的基金經理人最看好瑞士股市。
支撐行情的還有獲利預期改善。根據《彭博資訊》數據顯示，成分企業2027年獲利成長預期上升至10%，幾乎今年兩倍。
瑞士知名私人銀行薩夫拉薩辛銀行策略師Wolf von Rotberg上調評級至「跑贏大盤」，稱利率、美元及宏觀週期見頂三大因素均利好瑞士市場。
但估值隱憂浮現。經過一輪急漲，瑞士股指相對Stoxx 50的比價重回近兩年高位，估值偏貴限制上行空間。
此外，瑞士法郎本月因避險需求反彈，恐擾動出口導向大盤股獲利。市場正權衡防禦屬性與高估值壓力，修復行情能否延續仍待觀察。
paras_en: Swiss equities have risen 4.6% so far this month, while the Euro‑zone’s broad Stoxx 50 index has fallen 3.2% over the same period, delivering an excess return of nearly eight percentage points – the widest gap since March 2020. The divergence reflects European investors trimming risk exposure as financing costs rise, AI‑driven trading cools, and political turmoil spikes, prompting a shift toward defensive assets.

The gains are almost entirely driven by three heavyweight stocks: Roche up 12%, Novartis up 6.7% and Nestlé up 10%. These three long‑standing defensive leaders account for almost half of the index’s weight and contributed the full upside of the index.

EFG Asset Management notes that capital is flowing out of crowded AI trades and back into solid‑earning, low‑rate‑sensitivity sectors such as pharmaceuticals and food. A Bank of America survey also shows that a net 16% of fund managers are most bullish on Swiss equities.

The rally is also supported by improving earnings expectations. Bloomberg data indicate that the component companies’ profit‑growth outlook for 2027 has risen to 10%, roughly double the forecast made earlier this year.

Wolf von Rotberg, a strategist at Swiss private bank Safra Sarasin, upgraded his rating to “outperform,” saying that peaking interest rates, a strong dollar and a top‑of‑the‑cycle macro environment are all favorable for the Swiss market.

However, valuation concerns are emerging. After a sharp rally, the Swiss index’s price‑to‑Stoxx 50 multiple has returned to near‑two‑year highs, making the market look expensive and capping further upside potential.

In addition, the Swiss franc has rebounded this month on safe‑haven demand, which could hurt profit margins of export‑oriented large‑cap stocks. The market is weighing defensive appeal against overvaluation pressure, and it remains to be seen whether the rally can be sustained.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元上漲 日元因AI股重挫轉強 法國債務疑慮拖累歐元
items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Rises, Yen Gains After AI Stock Plunge, French Debt Concerns Drag Euro
paras: 美元周五(23日)小幅上漲，美元指數本週變動不大。歐元則受法國政府公債遭拋售影響走低，法國債務風險溢酬升至2011年歐元區主權債務危機以來最高水準，歐元兌美元與日元均以週線收黑作收。日元受惠於週四AI概念股遭拋售引發的避險資金流入，兌美元本週上漲。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.25%，報101.82，本週上漲約0.03%。
市場對法國國內動盪加劇及預算問題惡化的憂慮，持續打擊歐元。法國內政部長Laurent Nuñez表示，法國將於週六部署7萬名警察，並由特種警力支援，以因應抗議活動。此外，穆迪（Moody’s）也可能於週五調降法國的信用評等。
Bannockburn Global Forex 首席市場策略師 Marc Chandler 表示，「今天歐洲債券市場的壓力已有所緩解，但穆迪稍晚對法國債務評等的檢視仍是一項挑戰。儘管馬克宏政府已威脅動用軍事力量平息社會動盪，但週末可能仍會有更多活動發生。」
歐元兌美元下跌0.21%，至1.1191美元，本週下跌約0.43%。
歐元兌日元跌幅更大，一度觸及175.08日圓，創2025年10月以來最低。歐元兌日元下跌0.11%，本週跌約1.1%。
日元兌美元下跌0.1%，至156.9日元，但本週上漲約0.7%，創下9月中旬以來最佳單週表現。
三菱日聯金融集團（MUFG）資深外匯分析師 Lee Hardman 表示，「隨著本週尾聲的避險交易氣氛升溫，日元持續維持在較強勢水準。」
央行政策會議成市場焦點
交易員正關注下週美國聯準會（Fed）、歐洲央行（ECB）及日本銀行（BoJ）的政策會議。市場預期三家央行都將維持利率不變，但投資人將尋找未來貨幣政策走向的線索。
根據倫敦證券交易所集團（LSEG）數據，週四股市遭拋售後，聯邦基金利率期貨交易員下調了對聯準會12月升息的押注，但市場仍認為升息機率達81%。
交易員目前預估，歐洲央行12月升息的機率為66%。投資人將仔細檢視任何有關利率前景的訊號。歐洲央行總裁拉加德（Christine Lagarde）9月底曾表示，面對通膨，採取適度的政策反應是合適的。
採購經理人指數（PMI）數據顯示，歐元區民間部門10月成長速度放緩，降至四個月來最疲弱水準，主要受到法國經濟活動再度萎縮拖累。
花旗經濟學家 Giada Giani 表示，「我們認為，這次數據下滑讓PMI回到與其他經濟成長指標一致的水準，而非意味著未來下行風險正在增加。法國仍是拖累因素，但歐元區其他地區依然展現韌性。」
日本方面，週五公布的數據顯示，9月核心消費者物價年增率九個月來首度超過日本央行2%的通膨目標。分析師表示，這項數據顯示價格壓力正擴大至更多領域，也強化日銀近期升息的理由。

paras_en: The dollar edged higher on Friday (the 23rd), with the DXY showing little change this week. The euro fell as French government bonds were sold off, pushing France's sovereign debt risk premium to its highest level since the Euro‑area crisis of 2011. Both the euro‑dollar and euro‑yen pairs closed the week in the red. The yen benefited from a flight‑to‑safety flow triggered by Thursday’s sell‑off in AI‑related stocks, rising against the dollar over the week.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.25% to 101.82, up about 0.03% for the week.

Market worries about escalating domestic turmoil in France and worsening budget issues continued to weigh on the euro. French Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez said France will deploy 70,000 police officers, supported by special forces, on Saturday to address protests. Moody’s also may downgrade France’s credit rating on Friday.

Marc Chandler, chief market strategist at Bannockburn Global Forex, said, “The pressure on European bond markets has eased today, but Moody’s later review of France’s debt rating remains a challenge. Although the Macron government has threatened to use force to quell social unrest, more activity could still occur over the weekend.”
The euro fell 0.21% against the dollar to $1.1191, down about 0.43% for the week.
The euro‑yen pair slipped further, briefly hitting ¥175.08, the lowest since October 2025, down 0.11% and about 1.1% for the week.
The yen slipped 0.1% to ¥156.9 per dollar, but is up roughly 0.7% for the week, marking its best weekly performance since mid‑September.
Lee Hardman, senior FX analyst at MUFG, said, “With the hedge‑fund atmosphere heating up toward the end of the week, the yen remains firmly on the stronger side.”
Central‑bank policy meetings become market focus

Traders are watching next week’s policy meetings of the U.S. Federal Reserve, the European Central Bank and the Bank of Japan. Markets expect all three central banks to keep rates unchanged, but investors will look for clues on future monetary‑policy direction.

According to data from the London Stock Exchange Group, after Thursday’s equity sell‑off, Fed‑funds futures traders reduced bets on a December rate hike, yet the market still sees an 81% probability of a hike.

Traders currently estimate a 66% chance that the ECB will raise rates in December. Investors will scrutinise any signals about the rate outlook. ECB President Christine Lagarde said at the end of September that a measured policy response to inflation is appropriate.

Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI) data showed that euro‑area private‑sector growth slowed in October to its weakest level in four months, mainly dragged down by a renewed contraction in French economic activity.

Citigroup economist Giada Giani said, “We think this data dip brings the PMI back in line with other growth indicators rather than signalling rising downside risk. France remains a drag, but the rest of the euro area continues to show resilience.”

In Japan, Friday’s data showed that September core CPI year‑over‑year finally exceeded the Bank of Japan’s 2% inflation target for the first time in nine months. Analysts said the figure indicates price pressure spreading to more sectors and bolsters the case for a near‑term rate hike by the BOJ.
Traders now assign a 61% probability to a BOJ rate increase in December.

items.title: 美銀Hartnett示警避險潮延續至11月中 股市、美元、殖利率齊跌
items.title_en: Bank of America’s Hartnett Warns Hedge Wave Will Persist Into Mid‑November, Stocks, Dollar and Yields All Falling
paras: 美銀(BAC-US) 策略師Michael Hartnett預期，市場避險情緒可能延續至11月中旬，債券殖利率、股市與美元恐同步下跌。圍繞人工智慧（AI）交易及美國期中選舉的不安情緒，正壓抑股市表現，促使投資人轉向防禦性資產。
Hartnett週五在致客戶的報告中表示：「我們在戰術上維持避險立場至11月中旬。」他預期，市場將出現殖利率下跌、股市下跌及美元下跌的交易格局。
他指出，市場仍須充分反映民主黨同時取得眾議院與參議院控制權的可能性。在他看來，這樣的選舉結果將終結當前低稅、低監管的政策環境，不利企業獲利成長。
至於風險偏好何時可能回升，Hartnett認為，若歐洲央行或法國政府出手扭轉法國公債賣壓，可能成為訊號之一。
近期令市場不安的AI超大規模雲端服務商債券利差，也是一項觀察重點。他表示，若這些企業削減資本支出，或宣布「極大規模」的股權融資，使債券利差見頂，也可能緩解市場壓力。
儘管疑慮升溫，資金仍持續流入AI相關領域。美銀引述EPFR Global數據指出，科技股獲得7月以來最大單週資金流入。美銀本月公布的調查也顯示，全球投資人對科技股的曝險程度，升至2020年8月以來最高。
不過，最近幾天投資人也開始轉向防禦性資產，以因應油價上漲、融資成本攀升，以及AI交易可能逐漸泡沫化等風險。億萬富豪肯．格里芬（Ken Griffin）本週便警告，投資人「幾乎可以肯定」正身處AI泡沫之中。
資金轉向的跡象也反映在類股表現上。作為衡量市場廣度的指標，標普500等權重指數週四相對於市值加權的標普500指數，創下2024年以來最佳單日表現；防禦性較強的民生必需消費品類股，則可望締造1998年以來最佳單月表現。
paras_en: Bank of America (BAC-US) strategist Michael Hartnett expects the market’s hedging sentiment to continue into mid‑November, with bond yields, equities and the dollar likely to fall together. Anxiety surrounding AI‑driven trading and the U.S. midterm elections is suppressing stock performance and pushing investors toward defensive assets.

Hartnett wrote in a client note on Friday: “We will maintain a tactical hedging stance through mid‑November.” He anticipates a trading environment of falling yields, declining equities and a weaker dollar.

He noted that the market still needs to fully price in the possibility that Democrats could control both the House and the Senate. In his view, such an outcome would end the current low‑tax, low‑regulation policy regime, which is unfavorable for corporate profit growth.
As for when risk appetite might rebound, Hartnett sees a potential signal if the European Central Bank or the French government steps in to curb the selling pressure on French sovereign bonds.

Another focus is the widening credit spreads of ultra‑large AI cloud service providers, which have recently unsettled markets. He said that if these firms cut capital expenditures or announce “massive” equity financings that cap spreads, market pressure could ease.

Despite rising concerns, money continues to flow into AI‑related areas. Bank of America cites EPFR Global data showing the biggest weekly inflow into tech stocks since July, and its own survey this month indicating global investors’ exposure to tech stocks has risen to its highest level since August 2020.

However, in recent days investors have begun shifting toward defensive assets to hedge against rising oil prices, higher financing costs and the potential bubble in AI trading. Billionaire Ken Griffin warned this week that investors are “almost certainly” in an AI bubble.

The shift is also reflected in sector performance. As a breadth gauge, the equal‑weight S&P 500 posted its best single‑day performance this year on Thursday relative to the market‑cap‑weighted S&P 500, while defensive consumer‑staples stocks are on track for their strongest monthly gain since 1998.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元持平 日元走強 油價、AI與法國局勢引發市場不安
items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Flat, Yen Strengthens; Oil, AI and French Situation Stir Market Unease
paras: 美元周四(22日)大致持平，日元則有望創下近一個月來最大單日漲幅。由於股市表現脆弱、中東戰事延宕推升原油價格，以及市場對人工智慧（AI）未來投資報酬的疑慮升高，投資人紛紛尋求避險。
歐元兌美元下跌0.09%，至1.1222美元。法國社會動盪的疑慮，以及該國財政前景惡化的問題，影響力超過了AI交易的擔憂，後者則拖累美國股市走低。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.08%，報101.60。
Daiwa Capital Markets經濟研究主管Chris Scicluna表示，「AI讓人感到不安，油價也是如此……法國局勢同樣令人擔憂。」
在葉門武裝組織青年運動（Houthi）攻擊沙烏地阿拉伯後，市場擔心這個重要能源出口地區的供應將進一步受到干擾，推動油價上漲約3%，升至五個月高點。
日元兌美元升值0.75%，至156.96日元兌1美元。
日元走強的部分原因，也可能與匯價接近160這個關鍵水準有關。市場認為，一旦日元逼近160，日本當局進一步干預匯市、支撐日元的可能性就會升高。
Convera首席外匯與總體經濟策略師Kevin Ford將此稱為「干預溢價」，並指出，「每當日元接近160關卡，市場對央行出手干預的猜測就會升溫。」
在另一傳統避險貨幣瑞士法郎方面，美元兌瑞郎下跌0.42%，至每美元兌0.821瑞郎。
美元走勢愈來愈受到資本流動，以及與AI交易相關的經濟成長和通膨預期影響。上週由於市場對AI前景的疑慮升高，美元走跌，然而，週四市場對法國局勢的擔憂則占了上風。
富國銀行全球外匯策略主管Erik Nelson表示，「目前存在彼此競爭的市場敘事與脆弱環節，一方面是美國與AI相關的信用風險，另一方面則是法國的主權信用風險。過去幾天，這兩項因素持續拉鋸，有時其中一項比另一項更令人擔憂。」
他接著表示，「只要法國的風險比美國AI相關信用風險更受市場擔憂，歐元表現就會相對疲弱。」
法國總統馬克宏(Emmanuel Macron)週四表示，未來幾天將禁止「不合法」的抗議活動，並將上週末的暴動與掠奪事件歸咎於「煽動叛亂的」極左派團體及破壞公物者。
市場對法國能否妥善管理龐大債務負擔的疑慮，已衝擊法國公債，並引發對歐元區其他高負債國家的擔憂。週四，法國與德國10年期公債殖利率利差擴大至177.7個基點，為2011年以來最大。

paras_en: The dollar was roughly flat on Thursday (the 22nd), while the yen is poised to record its biggest single‑day gain in about a month. Weak equity markets, lingering Middle‑East conflict pushing up oil prices, and growing doubts about the future returns on artificial‑intelligence (AI) investments have led investors to seek safe havens.

The euro fell 0.09% against the dollar to $1.1222. Concerns over social unrest in France and the country’s deteriorating fiscal outlook outweighed worries about AI‑driven trading, which has been dragging U.S. equities lower.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, slipped 0.08% to 101.60.
Chris Scicluna, head of economic research at Daiwa Capital Markets, said, “AI is unsettling, oil prices are too… the situation in France is equally worrisome.”
After a Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia, markets feared further supply disruptions in this key energy‑export region, pushing oil prices up about 3% to a five‑month high.
The yen rose 0.75% against the dollar to ¥156.96 per $1.

One reason for the yen’s strength may be its approach to the critical ¥160 level. Market participants think that once the yen nears ¥160, Japanese authorities are more likely to intervene in the forex market to support the currency.

Kevin Ford, chief FX and macro strategist at Convera, called this an “intervention premium” and noted, “Whenever the yen approaches the 160 barrier, speculation about central‑bank intervention heats up.”
On another traditional safe‑haven currency, the Swiss franc, the dollar fell 0.42% to 0.821 CHF per $1.

The dollar’s trajectory is increasingly shaped by capital flows and expectations for economic growth and inflation linked to AI trading. Last week, heightened doubts about AI’s outlook pulled the dollar down, but on Thursday market concerns over France took precedence.

Erik Nelson, global FX strategy head at Wells Fargo, said, “There are competing market narratives and fragile points right now: on one side, U.S. AI‑related credit risk; on the other, France’s sovereign credit risk. In recent days these two factors have been tug‑of‑war, with one sometimes outweighing the other.”
He added, “As long as France’s risk is more concerning to the market than U.S. AI‑related credit risk, the euro will remain relatively weak.”
French President Emmanuel Macron said on Thursday that “illegal” protests would be banned in the coming days, blaming last weekend’s riots and looting on “subversive” far‑left groups and vandals.

Market doubts about France’s ability to manage its massive debt load have hit French government bonds and sparked worries about other highly indebted euro‑area countries. On Thursday the spread between French and German 10‑year yields widened to 177.7 basis points, the widest since 2011.

items.title_en: Philippine Central Bank Unexpectedly Raises Rate by 2 Points, Signaling Determination to Combat Inflation and Peso Depreciation
paras: 菲律賓央行(BSP)周四(22日)採取果斷行動，宣布將目標反向附買回利率調升2碼(0.5個百分點)至5.50%，以應對通膨擴大與披索匯率跌至歷史新低的雙重壓力，這項決策遠比市場預期更為激進。
媒體先前調查的25位經濟學家中，多達24位僅預估升息1碼，僅有1位準確預估升息2碼。央行在聲明中表示，價格壓力擴大需要「強烈」的回應，透過決斷的貨幣政策來遏制二次效應並錨定通膨預期，且已做好必要時採取進一步貨幣政策行動的準備。
自今年早些時候伊朗爆發衝突以來，儘管菲律賓經濟正經歷疫情以來最慢的成長步伐，央行已累計升息125個基點(5碼)。然而通膨前景未見顯著改善，9月消費者物價指數(CPI)年增率衝上7.2%，扭轉了連續4個月的放緩趨勢，使今年以來的平均通膨率達到5.4%，遠高於央行3%的目標。
此外，披索對美元匯率在上周跌破63關卡後續創新低，加劇了依賴進口能源與食品的進口通膨風險。央行維持今年通膨預測於6.1%，但將2027年預測由5.4%顯著調升至6.0%，預計要到2028年才會降至3.3%。
菲律賓央行總裁雷莫洛納(Eli Remolona)表示：「通膨預測比我們預想的還要糟糕，這讓我們感受到壓制通膨壓力的緊迫感。」
雷莫洛納指出，中東局勢升溫推升了國際油價與運輸票價，而未來最大的風險是嚴重的聖嬰現象乾旱可能衝擊農業生產。他同時對披索疲軟及其對進口通膨的影響表達憂慮，但明確表示央行不會耗盡外匯存底來捍衛特定的匯率關卡，並補充指出，在政府支出改善下，國內經濟預計於2027年第一季復甦。
做為唯一精準預測本次決策的專家，菲律賓群島銀行首席經濟學家Emilio Neri Jr.認為，這次大幅升息強化了菲律賓央行對抗通膨的信譽與決心。
不過，Pantheon Macroeconomics經濟學家Miguel Chanco提醒，12月會議是否進一步緊縮仍非定局。他說：「今日超出預期的調整，其動機可能是將今年最後一次會議中原本無爭議的25個基點升息提前實施。」
paras_en: The Philippine central bank (BSP) took decisive action on Thursday (the 22nd), announcing a 2‑point (0.5 percentage‑point) increase in its target reverse repurchase rate to 5.50% to address the dual pressures of widening inflation and the peso sliding to a historic low, a move far more aggressive than markets had expected.

Among the 25 economists surveyed by the media, 24 only forecast a 1‑point hike, with just one correctly predicting a 2‑point increase. In its statement, the bank said that expanding price pressures require a “strong” response, using decisive monetary policy to curb secondary effects and anchor inflation expectations, and it is ready to take further policy action if needed.

Since the outbreak of conflict in Iran earlier this year, even as the Philippine economy has been growing at its slowest pace since the pandemic, the central bank has cumulatively raised rates by 125 basis points (5 points). Yet the inflation outlook has not improved markedly; September’s consumer price index (CPI) rose 7.2% year‑on‑year, reversing four months of slowdown and pushing the year‑to‑date average inflation to 5.4%, well above the bank’s 3% target.

Moreover, after the peso fell below the 63 per‑dollar mark last week and set a new low, import‑driven inflation risks have intensified given the country’s reliance on imported energy and food. The bank kept its 2024 inflation forecast at 6.1% but lifted its 2027 projection sharply from 5.4% to 6.0%, expecting inflation to fall to 3.3% only by 2028.
BSP Governor Eli Remolona said, “The inflation outlook is worse than we anticipated, which makes us feel the urgency of suppressing inflation pressures.”

Remolona noted that heightened tensions in the Middle East have pushed up international oil prices and freight rates, and that the biggest future risk is a severe El Niño‑induced drought that could hit agricultural output. He also expressed concern over the weak peso and its impact on imported inflation, but made clear the bank will not deplete foreign‑exchange reserves to defend a specific exchange‑rate level, adding that, with improved government spending, the domestic economy is expected to recover in the first quarter of 2027.

As the only expert who accurately forecast the decision, Emilio Neri Jr., chief economist at the Bank of the Philippine Islands, said the sharp rate hike reinforces the BSP’s credibility and resolve in fighting inflation.

However, Pantheon Macroeconomics economist Miguel Chanco warned that whether the December meeting will tighten further remains uncertain. He said, “Today’s surprise adjustment may be motivated by moving forward the undisputed 25‑basis‑point hike that was slated for the last meeting of the year.”

items.title: 人工智慧疑慮再起 資金湧入美債、日元與瑞郎避險
items.title_en: AI Concerns Resurface, Funds Flood Into US Treasuries, Yen and Franc as Safe Havens
paras: 由於投資人對人工智慧(AI)交易的獲利前景疑慮再起，導致股市出現震盪，避險資金隨之湧入美國公債、日元及瑞士法郎等避險資產。
美國政府公債殖利率全線下跌至少 3 個基點，其中 30 年期美債殖利率降至 5.38%，創下 9 月 23 日以來最低。同時，澳洲與紐西蘭公債價格也同步走揚，日元兌美元匯率升幅高達 0.3%。
星展銀行(DBS Bank Ltd.)資深利率策略師 Eugene Leow 表示：「隨著投資人重新審視與 AI 相關的資產，近期的市場情緒似乎更加動搖。」他指出，市場對獲利能力與投資報酬率(ROI)的疑慮正在逐漸浮現。在美債殖利率以近期標準衡量仍處於高位的情況下，投資人希望透過轉向美債尋求安全感，以規避部分風險。
股票市場的跌勢，讓美債重新發揮了避險資產的作用；在此之前，對通膨升溫的擔擔曾推動美債殖利率在最近幾周升至多年新高。
儘管沙烏地阿拉伯發生的致命襲擊事件引發市場對供應前景的疑慮，進而推升原油價格，但資金對美債的避險買盤依然強勁。能源成本上升加深了市場對通膨的擔憂，並促使交易員預期美國聯準會(Fed)及全球其他主要中央銀行將進一步升息。
彭博追蹤美債報酬率的指標在 9 月創下近兩年來最大單月跌幅後，10 月已回升約 1.2%。
澳洲國家銀行(National Australia Bank)利率策略主管 Kenneth Crompton 對此指出：「儘管油價一直在緩步上揚，但美債再次吸引了避險資金的流入。」
除美債外，全球其他主要債市與匯市也受到影響。澳洲 10 年期公債殖利率下跌 3 個基點至 5.25%，紐西蘭 2 年期公債殖利率下滑 2 個基點至 3.91%。在匯市方面，日元兌美元升值 0.3% 至 157.68 日元兌 1 美元，瑞士法郎上漲 0.2%，而美元指數指標則變化不大。
法國Credit Agricole策略師 David Forrester 分析：「標普 500 指數期貨的回檔為日元帶來了推升力道。」他強調：「重要之處在於，這種升勢是全面性的，甚至對美元同樣上揚，這凸顯出在 AI 熱潮遭遇波折時，日元所具備的避險資產地位。」
paras_en: Investors' renewed doubts about the profit prospects of AI trading have caused stock market volatility, prompting safe‑haven money to pour into US government bonds, the Japanese yen and the Swiss franc.

US government bond yields fell across the board by at least three basis points, with the 30‑year Treasury yield dropping to 5.38%, the lowest since September 23. At the same time, Australian and New Zealand government bond prices rose, and the yen gained about 0.3% against the dollar.

Eugene Leow, senior rate strategist at DBS Bank Ltd., said: “As investors re‑evaluate AI‑related assets, market sentiment has become more unsettled.” He noted that concerns over profitability and ROI are emerging, and with Treasury yields still high by recent standards, investors are turning to US bonds for safety and to hedge some risk.
The equity market decline has restored the role of Treasuries as a safe‑haven asset; previously, worries about rising inflation had pushed Treasury yields up to multi‑year highs in recent weeks.

Although a deadly attack in Saudi Arabia raised supply‑side concerns and lifted oil prices, buying pressure for US Treasuries remained strong. Higher energy costs have deepened inflation worries and led traders to expect further rate hikes from the US Federal Reserve and other major central banks worldwide.
Bloomberg’s Treasury yield index, after posting the biggest monthly drop in nearly two years in September, has recovered about 1.2% in October.
Kenneth Crompton, head of rate strategy at National Australia Bank, said: “Even though oil prices have been inching higher, US Treasuries are once again attracting safe‑haven flows.”

Beyond Treasuries, other major bond and currency markets were also affected. Australian 10‑year government bond yields fell three basis points to 5.25%, New Zealand two‑year yields slipped two basis points to 3.91%. In the FX market, the yen appreciated 0.3% to 157.68 per dollar, the Swiss franc rose 0.2%, while the US dollar index was largely unchanged.

David Forrester, a strategist at Credit Agricole in France, analyzed: “The pull‑back in S&P 500 futures provided upward momentum for the yen.” He stressed: “The key point is that this rise is broad‑based, even lifting the dollar, highlighting the yen’s safe‑haven status when the AI hype hits a snag.”

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元下跌 交易員等待Fed下週決策
items.title_en: <New York Forex Market> Dollar Falls as Traders Await Fed Decision Next Week
paras: 美元周三(21日)下跌，交易員評估油價上漲再度引發的通膨風險，並等待聯準會(Fed)下週召開會議。澳幣則因央行官員發表偏緊縮言論而走強。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.14%，報101.65。
加拿大豐業銀行首席外匯策略師Shaun Osborne表示，「目前市場並沒有一個主導全局的明確主題……我認為這種情況至少會持續到下週聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）會議前。我們需要了解聯準會的想法。」
美國與伊朗持續交戰，加深了市場對油價推升通膨可能影響聯準會政策的擔憂。
聯邦基金利率期貨交易員認為，聯準會下週升息的可能性不高，下一次升息預計將落在12月。聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)也不太可能暗示未來的政策走向。

paras_en: The dollar fell on Wednesday (the 21st) as traders assessed renewed inflation risks from rising oil prices and waited for the Federal Reserve's meeting next week. The Australian dollar strengthened on tighter‑tone comments from central bank officials.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY) tracking the greenback against six major currencies slipped 0.14% to 101.65.

Scotiabank’s chief FX strategist Shaun Osborne said, “There isn’t a clear, dominant theme driving the market right now… I think this will last at least until the FOMC meeting next week. We need to understand the Fed’s thinking.”
The ongoing conflict between the United States and Iran has heightened market concerns that higher oil prices could push inflation up and affect Fed policy.
Federal‑funds futures traders see little chance of a rate hike next week, with the next increase expected in December. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh is also unlikely to signal future policy direction.
However, Osborne added, “I think the market will at least further assess the timing of any future hikes next week, and expectations will become clearer.”
Investors are also worried about how long the AI‑driven market rally can last.

Even though last week’s data showed September U.S. CPI accelerating, the dollar remained weak. Earlier optimism toward the AI sector had drawn capital into the United States, boosting growth and inflation expectations and supporting the greenback.

CIBC Capital Markets FX strategist Noah Buffam said, “U.S. economic growth is largely driven by the overall AI trading rally. That keeps inflation above target, so AI’s impact on the U.S. is greater than on other countries.”
Elon Musk said on Tuesday that merging his SpaceX and Tesla businesses was “a good idea,” and SpaceX reported its first profit since going public, easing some market concerns about equities.
On the other hand, AI server maker Super Micro projected quarterly revenue and margins above Wall Street expectations.
The euro rose 0.01% against the dollar to $1.1237.
Large anti‑government protests in France and a worsening fiscal outlook continue to pressure the euro. France’s 10‑year bond yields rose on Wednesday to a 24‑year high.

Saxo Global macro‑strategy head John Hardy said, “France’s debt problem is hard to solve. They really need to take appropriate fiscal adjustment measures, lower debt levels, and at least show concern for the debt‑development trend.”

French President Emmanuel Macron pledged to prevent a repeat of last weekend’s riots and looting. Meanwhile, the Yellow Vest movement has announced plans for a large march in Paris on Saturday, which will be the next major test for the French government.
Elsewhere, RBA deputy governor Andrew Hauser told a Citi conference that the inflation outlook was “clearly deteriorating,” fueling Australian‑dollar gains.
The Australian dollar rose 0.41% against the U.S. dollar to $0.7031.
The British pound gained 0.16% against the dollar to $1.34. Data showed September UK inflation rose more than expected, strengthening the case for a BoE rate hike in November.
The pound also rose against the euro to its highest level in 17 months.

The yen edged up 0.02% to ¥158.12 per dollar. BoJ deputy governor Ryozo Himino said Japan’s underlying inflation is near the 2% target, the financial environment remains accommodative, and there is still room to raise borrowing costs in the future.
